jobs.company: Community Youth Center of San Francisco
jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.title: Program Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Position Details**

**Title**: Outpatient Program Care Coordinator

**Classification**: Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)

**Location**: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in-person and complete documentation remotely)

**Regular Work Schedule**: Full time, M-F

**Compensation:**

* $34.62 per hour (plus additional 10% Spanish language differential for qualified candidates)

The **Program Care Coordinator** connects clients who have completed their initial referral screening to an Outpatient Program care team. Utilizing a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, this role ensures that clients and families have the space, resources, access, and advocacy needed to amplify their own voice and choice in pursuing the level of care they deserve.

The **Program Care Coordinator** facilitates initial scheduling, connecting clients to treatment teams, monitoring follow-up, and provides immediate case management to support waitlisted clients until team assignment. The position engages internal and external providers to champion team-based care practices across service phases. The ideal candidate brings flexibility, organization, initiative, creativity, and an inclusive approach, backed by deep knowledge of the unique challenges facing children and families, especially those involved in foster care.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Track and manage youth referrals across electronic health records, spreadsheets, and Google Workspace.
* Provide short-term case management and care coordination for waitlisted youth, complete risk assessments and provide immediate crisis resources.
* Obtain clinical documentation (ROIs, past assessments) to inform care planning.
* Organize and facilitate program orientations for new referrals.
* Conduct proactive outreach to re-engage disengaged clients and connect them to care.
* Serve as a backup Child & Family Team (CFT) Meeting facilitator.
* Review CFT Care Plans to ensure state regulatory compliance.
* Complete compliant Medi-Cal documentation within 48 hours of service.
* Monitor client feedback to drive continuous program improvement.
* Cultivate and strengthen strategic community partnerships, and plan/execute monthly community gatherings for participants and staff.
* Uphold agency mission, ethical standards, and mandated reporting obligations while consistently participate in supervision, team meetings, and professional development.

**Qualifications:**

* **Minimum educational requirements:** Bachelor's degree with relevant experience. Candidates with an Associate of Arts Degree with long-term relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience facilitating events, team meetings and/or trainings.
* Ability to assess needs, strengths & provide crisis intervention and de-escalation,
* Passionate about working with young adults who have experienced complex trauma.
* Strong organizational, written & communication skills.
* Values working on a team, cultural humility, compassion, inclusivity, self-reflection, ongoing personal growth, self-care and social justice.

**Competencies:**

* Demonstrated experience working with transitional age youth (TAY) and families who may be involved in the child welfare system.
* Ability to work with clients who have complex traumatic histories and other attachment difficulties.
* **Cultural Humility** - Knowledge of issues of race, class and ethnicity.
* **Efficiency and Time Management** - Ability to be well-organized and complete timely documentation.
* **Collaboration and Team Functioning** - Ablility to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

### ***Why work here?***

* **Be part of a compassionate, driven team that is social justice-focused:** We have Staff Affinity Groups such as Staff of Color, LGBTQ+, Equity and Inclusion, Health and Wellness, and more!

* **Make a difference for the Bay Area's most vulnerable populations:** We serve hundreds of vulnerable kids and their families each year to create positive changes in their lives!

* **Access a growth-oriented learning community:** As a Joint Commission Accredited agency, we are dedicated to providing the highest standard of care, and offer extensive clinical trainings and seminars led by field experts.

### **Benefits:**

* Employer-paid Medical Benefits for Employees
  + 100% employer-paid dental and vision
  + Dependent medical, dental and vision (50% employer-paid)
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA and commuter plans
* 100% employer-paid life insurance long-term disability insurance
* Voluntary accident, term life and hospital indemnity insurance
* 403(b) and ROTH retirement plan options, employer contribution targeted at 7.5% after first year of employment
* Quarterly (5-10%) and annual incentive compensation (10%)
* Three weeks PTO during the first year of employment, 4+ weeks PTO with additional years of service
* 12 paid holidays plus one paid floating holiday per year
* 4 paid self-care days per year
* Wellness stipend ($100.00 per month)
* Professional development stipend and CEUs for trainings
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

***Join us and make a difference in the lives of vulnerable children and families in the Bay Area.***

*WCC is passionate about leading and encouraging open conversations around race, gender, power, and privilege and how these impact community mental health.* *We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diminishing the influence of privilege and discrimination in our field and our workplace, whether due to differences concerning age, citizenship, color, disability, marital or parental

jobs.company: California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems
jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The California Health Care Safety Net Institute (SNI) partners with California’s public health care systems to optimize and transform the ecosystem of care, providing high-quality, patient-led, and equitable care for all. Together with our advocacy partner, the California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems, SNI works to strengthen care delivery systems by shaping the policies and programs that drive improvement and creating a community where system leaders can exchange ideas and advance shared priorities.

SNI and CAPH represent California’s 17 public health care systems, which include the county-owned or affiliated systems and the University of California academic medical centers. These systems serve as the foundation of the state’s safety net, delivering care to all who need it, regardless of insurance coverage, immigration status, ability to pay, or other circumstances. Public health care systems primarily serve people from historically marginalized communities, including persons of color, individuals experiencing financial hardship or homelessness, and individuals with complex health and social needs.

Although SNI and CAPH are separate legal entities, they function day-to-day as a matrix organization, with SNI contributing to CAPH’s policy and advocacy efforts, CAPH offering technical expertise to SNI’s programs, and the organizations working together to achieve shared goals for our member systems.

SNI and CAPH are committed to advancing equity and serve as an Equal Opportunity Employer with a strong commitment to racial, cultural, and ethnic diversity. Qualified applicants of all races, people with all abilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

**SNI’s Programs**

SNI brings together systems’ leaders from clinical, quality, data, finance, and operational areas through in-person and virtual convenings, communities of practice, webinars, and our CAPH/SNI Annual Conference. By creating a community where leaders can exchange ideas and problem-solve, SNI helps systems work through complex issues and apply successful strategies from peers in their own settings.

Beyond these convenings, SNI creates practical resources and content to surface and share what is working across the field. These include lessons learned briefs, roadmaps, case studies, and articles drawn from member systems’ experiences.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

The Program Coordinator plays an essential support role in planning and implementing SNI’s programs. Working closely with SNI and CAPH staff, the Coordinator will:

· Support the design and delivery of in-person and virtual learning events for health system leaders across SNI’s program areas (e.g., protecting Medicaid coverage and access, strengthening health equity, improving cost effectiveness and efficiency).

o Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, including developing and managing workplans, scheduling speaker prep calls, creating and administering pre-event surveys and post-event evaluations, and providing day-of support during events, among other duties.

o Work with the program team, particularly the team lead, to identify systems’ needs and develop program content and materials.

· Lead the Quality Leaders Awards ceremony and luncheon during CAPH/SNI’s Annual Conference.

o Prepare and disseminate the call for applications and organize submissions.

o Coordinate the judging process by helping to identify external judges, scheduling judging calls, and reviewing and scoring submissions with the judges’ panel.

o Oversee the awards ceremony and luncheon at the annual conference, including serving as the point of contact for awardees, preparing the SNI Board Chair to moderate, and managing all aspects of the day-of event, among other duties.

o Additionally, support the annual conference team in identifying and preparing conference speakers.

· Perform administrative duties, such as scheduling meetings, summarizing meeting notes, and printing and compiling meeting materials.

· Complete other duties and projects as needed.

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a health-related field, or commensurate experience.

· Minimum of 1 year of work experience, which may include internships and fellowships. Experience working in a health care setting and/or public agency a plus.

· Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a timely, organized manner with .

· Strong writing and editing skills. Adept at translating complex information into accessible language for a variety of audiences.

· Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Zoom. Preferred experience working with WordPress, Constant Contact, and/or online collaborative tools, such as Miro.

· Comfortable using AI tools to improve work quality and productivity while exercising independent thinking and ownership of final work.

· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to interact professionally and courteously with health system leadership, consultants, and peers.

· Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn on the fly, and work effectively in teams, as well as independently.

· Understanding of California’s health care landscape, particularly programs that serve Medicaid and uninsured patients, a plus.

**Work Environment**

CAPH/SNI operates in a hybrid work environment, with two required in-person days (Monday and Wednesday) at the office in Oakland, CA for those living 40 miles or less from the office; one required in-person day (Monday) for those living farther away. The remaining days are conducted remotely.

This role requires occasional in-state travel, including overnight travel for in-person convenings and the annual conference.

The starting salary range for this position is $65,000-$75,000. SNI offers an extremely competitive benefits package, as well as opportunities to attend professional conferences and participate in professional development trainings.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We are seeking a hands-on **Project Coordinator** to assist with project management and scheduling, as well as contract administration. To support challenging technical goals, you will take ownership of, and create streamlined processes for, management, tracking, and delivery of programmatic requirements. Working closely with executive leadership and the overall team, your responsibilities will include: (a) program support for Principal Investigators, including report creation and submission, project scheduling/tracking, and program management; (b) taking possession of contract review and administration; (c) distill and convey complex ideas to technical and general audiences; (d) adding structure and efficient processes to our organization while maintaining our get-it-done culture. The ideal candidate is unafraid to dive into new concepts, can handle and prioritize multiple tasks, and has broad experience generating high-quality written and presentation materials.
  
  
**Location: This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA (Bay Area)**

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Do**

* Work with a team of physicists and engineers to help synthesize and refine content for the target audience
* Create and edit content, including figures, images, and diagrams, for contract deliverables (e.g., monthly and/or quarterly reports – primarily PPT-based)
* Support kickoff, interim, and final review meetings through content creation/scheduling
* Provide scheduling/organization function via weekly deliverable tracker + Project Management software (Smartsheet and Jira)
* Participate in internal and external team calls/meetings/visits
* Contract review (flow down requirements/assist with revision requests/etc.) and tracking; distill and convey requirements to technical team
* Support accounting through creation/submission of invoices
* Contribute to final reports and proposals

**What We're Looking For:**

* To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.
* Strong time management, organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills; able to manage priorities and workflow
* Ability to comb through and edit complex technical details and jargon
* Strong interpersonal skills; discuss/refine complex ideas; negotiate personalities/styles to achieve the best product
* Strong attention to detail; pride in work product
* Proactive; looks for opportunities to make the organization and their co-workers better
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver high quality work while managing multiple deadlines

 **Benefits**

Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including:

* Platinum-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Employer 401(k) contributions
* 20 days of paid time off & 11 paid holidays
* Paid parental leave
* Fully stocked kitchen

**Pay Range**

The approximate base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience level.

*Vector Atomic is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.*

*Vector Atomic does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.*

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym-we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Sales & Service Overnights, Sales & Service Associates, and Kids' Club Attendants (at clubs with a Kids' Club), and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club (where applicable), club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. Club Attendants report directly to the Operations Manager, who owns club cleanliness standards and results. The Operations Manager drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment. The Operations Manager writes and manages team schedules and is the club's owner for wage-and-hour compliance, ensuring every team member receives compliant meal and rest periods and that timecards are accurate, reviewed, and documented. The extent of hands-on involvement in these duties varies with club size, staffing, and business needs.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial construction projects, including tenant improvements, renovations, and specialized construction within the life sciences, healthcare, technology, and education sectors.

This position will be responsible for managing all aspects of construction projects, from preconstruction and estimating through project execution and final closeout. The Project Manager will oversee budgets, schedules, subcontractors, contracts, and client relationships while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in commercial tenant improvements, renovations, and technically complex construction projects, with experience managing multiple trades, fast-track schedules, and demanding client expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage commercial construction projects from preconstruction through final completion and closeout.
* Oversee project budgets, schedules, contracts, procurement, and overall financial performance.
* Coordinate estimating, subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, and subcontractor buyout.
* Prepare and manage project proposals, contracts, change orders, and project documentation.
* Develop and maintain construction schedules, project milestones, and procurement timelines.
* Work closely with Superintendents and Project Engineers to coordinate field operations and project execution.
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, meeting minutes, and project correspondence.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Oversee construction activities involving architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing trades.
* Manage commercial tenant improvements, renovations, laboratory build-outs, and specialized interior construction.
* Monitor project costs, financial forecasts, owner billing, and subcontractor invoices.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, constructability issues, and project risks.
* Coordinate construction activities within occupied buildings and operational facilities.
* Lead owner meetings, subcontractor coordination meetings, and project progress reviews.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards.
* Manage project closeout, punch lists, inspections, commissioning coordination, and final turnover.
* Maintain strong client relationships and support future business development opportunities.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to Project Engineers and Assistant Project Managers.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of commercial construction project management experience.
* Strong experience with commercial tenant improvements, renovations, or specialized construction projects.
* Experience managing projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Proven ability to manage project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, and client relationships.
* Strong understanding of construction processes, estimating, procurement, and cost management.
* Knowledge of commercial construction trades, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.
* Experience managing RFIs, submittals, change orders, and construction documentation.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Experience coordinating multiple subcontractors and managing fast-paced construction schedules.
* Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Microsoft Project.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with life sciences, healthcare, technology, education, or other technically complex commercial projects.
* Experience managing laboratory construction, cleanrooms, medical facilities, or specialized tenant improvements.
* Background in occupied-building renovations, phased construction, and fast-track project delivery.
* Familiarity with complex HVAC, electrical, plumbing, process piping, and specialty building systems.
* Experience with design-build projects and preconstruction services.
* Knowledge of commissioning, equipment installation, and specialty MEP coordination.
* Proficiency with Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar construction management software.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Established relationships with subcontractors, architects, engineers, and commercial construction clients.

Together, these programs bring interdisciplinary teams and partners together to translate scientific discovery into meaningful educational, clinical, and community impact.

The ALBA Language Neurobiology Lab and Dyslexia Center seek an experienced, highly collaborative Program Manager to provide strategic and operational leadership across this growing portfolio. Serving as a key partner to the Director, the Program Manager will translate strategic priorities into clear, coordinated plans and provide the structure and oversight needed to move initiatives from concept through development, implementation, evaluation, and dissemination. The role will establish priorities and timelines, coordinate interdependent projects and teams, monitor progress and resources, anticipate and resolve barriers, and develop the systems and processes necessary to ensure work remains organized, aligned, and on track across multiple initiatives, partnerships, and funding streams.

Working closely with the Director, faculty, researchers, staff, educators, technology and product teams, community partners, funders, and other external stakeholders, the Program Manager will serve as a central point of coordination across the Lab and Center. The role will ensure that priorities and decisions established under the Director’s leadership are effectively translated into action, that commitments and deliverables are followed through, and that the collective work of the programs is coordinated and visible to internal and external stakeholders. The Program Manager will also strengthen communication and collaboration across teams, facilitate strategic partnerships, and support reporting and dissemination of program accomplishments and impact.

This position requires an individual who can operate effectively at both the strategic and execution levels—helping shape how organizational priorities are translated into programs while building the operational infrastructure required to deliver them successfully. The ideal candidate will be comfortable navigating a complex academic and research environment, managing multiple priorities and stakeholders, creating clarity where processes are still evolving, and establishing scalable systems that enable the Director and multidisciplinary teams to execute effectively and advance the broader mission of the ALBA Lab and Dyslexia Center.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable project and implementation plans.
* Strong project and program management skills, including experience developing work plans, managing timelines, coordinating deliverables, identifying risks, and resolving barriers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and develop actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and diverse internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deadlines with a high degree of independence, judgment, and accountability.
* Proficiency with common project-management, collaboration, data, and productivity tools.
  

**Preferred Qualfications**

* Master's degree, PhD, or other advanced degree in a relevant field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable project/program management training.
* Experience managing academic or research programs within a leading research university, healthcare institution, or comparable organization.
* Experience supporting neuroscience, cognitive science, education, learning sciences, child development, health, or related research. Experience with translational research and/or implementation science.
* Experience managing grants, contracts, subcontracts, program budgets, and/or externally funded initiatives.

jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to join the International Testing Programs (ITP) team within Global Product Quality. In this role, you will own Meta's payments testing programs and contribute to the broader ITP mission of ensuring our products work as intended in every market we serve. You will work on payments testing across Meta's international markets — coordinating in-country validation of payment experiences with real local payment methods, managing the payment instruments Meta teams test with, defining coverage and quality metrics, and applying automation to scale how testing gets delivered.Payments are how people and businesses transact across Meta's family of apps, and simulated test environments only go so far — confirming that payments work takes validation in-market, with the methods people actually use. You will shape how payment experiences are tested across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, and generative AI products, turning results into recommendations that product and engineering teams act on.Beyond payments, you will contribute to the broader International Testing Programs mission of ensuring Meta's products work as intended in every market we serve. That means supporting test coverage, execution, and program operations across the wider portfolio, and helping the team scale through automation — bringing what you learn from payments testing to how international testing gets delivered overall, and vice versa.  
  
  

### **Program Manager. International Payments Testing Responsibilities:**

* Own active payments testing programs — manage day-to-day delivery of end-to-end payment tests executed in-country using real local payment methods, including market and payment method prioritization, test scoping, execution cadence, results triage, and follow-through with product and engineering owners
* Own passive payment credentials programs — manage sourcing, provisioning, and lifecycle of real payment instruments (cards, bank accounts, SIMs, merchant accounts) for Meta teams to test payment flows, working with privacy, legal, compliance, finance, and enterprise infrastructure on handling requirements
* Contribute as an active member of ITP beyond payments — support test coverage, execution, and program operations across the wider portfolio
* Help the team scale through automation and AI tooling that reduces manual execution, triage, and reporting work so coverage grows without headcount growing with it
* Partner with payments product and engineering teams, QA leaders across product areas, external testing partners, analytics teams, localization program managers, and Meta's privacy, legal, compliance, and finance teams
* Design testing methodologies and run in-market validation across multiple geographies simultaneously
* Define coverage and quality metrics for payments testing programs and track results to drive product decisions
* Apply AI and automation as tools to deliver testing faster and at greater scale

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or quality program management
* Experience managing vendor relationships and external testing partners at scale
* Experience with ambiguity and building programs where processes are not yet fully defined
* Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, legal, compliance, and finance teams

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

jobs.title: Research Program Manager, Safety Systems
jobs.description:
Research Program Management - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models. We work across research, engineering, product, and policy to understand risks, develop and validate safeguards, and support responsible deployment.

Our work spans safeguards research and deployment, safety assessments, launch readiness, and trusted-access programs for advanced capabilities. We address risks including biological and cyber misuse and misalignment, with programs that strengthen safety across models and products.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring Research Program Managers across AI Safeguards and Frontier Risks Safety. You’ll lead programs that develop and improve the safeguards used across our models and products, or assess and mitigate risks associated with frontier capabilities, launches, and trusted-access programs.

You will partner with researchers development and deployment decisions. We’re looking for people who combine strong technical judgment, experience managing complex research programs, and a commitment to AI safety.

These roles are based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Shape safety programs and technical roadmaps.** Partner with research and engineering leads to define goals investments.
* **Drive safeguards development and deployment.** Translate safety research into safeguards across models and products. Maintain an end-to-end view of safeguard coverage, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement for one or more risk areas, and drive a roadmap that advances across launches.
* **Coordinate evaluations and safety assessments.** Organize capability evaluations, alignment and control assessments, adversarial testing, and safeguard stress-testing, including risks from autonomous and multi-agent systems. Support embedded assessments throughout model development, internal use, and deployment.
* **Drive safety readiness and trusted-access programs.** Coordinate safety requirements and execution across frontier model launches and deployments. Work with technical teams to define assessment scope and the evidence needed to inform safety and access decisions.
* **Turn findings into improvements.** Triage safeguard gaps, jailbreaks, and overflagging with accountable teams. Establish owners and escalation paths, track remediation and regression testing, and turn recurring issues into research and engineering improvements.
* **Strengthen the evidence behind safety decisions.** Support safety cases that connect claims to evaluations, safeguards, assumptions, and remaining uncertainty. Surface evidence gaps and unresolved risks, and communicate methods, results, limitations, and follow-up actions through assessment reports, system cards, and updates to decision-makers.

jobs.title: Sales Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently.

This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale.

**About the role**
------------------

The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready.

Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own the sales onboarding program.** Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track.
* **Build the BDR ramp.** Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer.
* **Build and maintain content.** Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date.
* **Facilitate live sessions.** Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers.
* **Run cohort logistics.** Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work.
* **Certify field readiness.** Design and run role-specific certifications using clear rubrics. For BDRs, that means cold-call, email and qualification certifications. For AEs, it means pitch, discovery and demo certifications. Both roles also certify on tools. Calibrate scoring with BDR and sales managers, give actionable feedback, and decide when a new hire is ready to sell on their own.
* **Partner with frontline managers.** Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews.
* **Measure and improve.** Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort.
* **Scale with leverage.** Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

The best candidates are strong facilitators who also design programs and run operations well. You can command a room, build a curriculum from a blank page, and keep a complicated cohort calendar running smoothly. You hold a high bar for readiness and know how to tell a manager when a seller isn't there yet.

**Must-haves**

* 2–4 years in sales enablement, sales onboarding or sales training, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or AI company. Experience carrying a quota or managing sellers is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing and running a sales onboarding or ramp program end to end, with measurable impact on ramp time or productivity.
* Excellent live facilitation, virtual and in person, with sellers at different experience levels, from early-career BDRs to seasoned AEs.
* Experience designing and running certifications or skills assessments (such as cold-call, pitch, discovery or demo) using rubrics that sales managers trust.
* Strong program management and operational rigor. You can run several overlapping cohorts, schedules and stakeholders without dropping details.
* Working knowledge of modern sales methods (such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message or similar), outbound prospecting and the full sales cycle from first touch to close.
* Comfort learning technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. You can learn an AI product well enough to teach and demo it.
* Fluency with the sales tech stack, such as Salesforce, a conversation-intelligence tool and an LMS or content-management platform.
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment where the product changes weekly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience onboarding sellers for AI, developer or other technically complex products.
* Background in instructional design or adult learning.
* Previous experience as a BDR/SDR or as a BDR/SDR manager.

This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Account Management
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re rapidly moving upmarket, scaling our Strategic Account Management organization, and seeking an experienced, growth-minded people leader with a proven track record of leading high-performing sales or account management teams. As a Manager of Strategic Account Management at Rippling, you will lead, coach, and scale a team of Account Managers who serve as primary relationship owners for our most Strategic customers. You will drive team strategy, mentor ICs through complex growth and retention opportunities, and foster operational excellence to achieve company targets for customer adoption, net retention, and revenue growth.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Hire, recruit, onboard, and retain top-tier AM talent to scale the Strategic Accounts team.
* Coach and develop Strategic AMs through 1:1s, pipeline reviews, call coaching, and active deal support to elevate team performance and career progression.
* Drive performance management and hold the team accountable to key operational metrics, pipeline generation, cross-sell quota attainment, and retention goals.
* Act as an executive sponsor on high-stakes customer renewals, expansion opportunities, and escalations to support deal execution.
* Partner closely with Cross-Functional Leadership (Product, Support, RevOps, and Customer Success) to align on go-to-market strategies, improve internal processes, and advocate for customer needs.
* Establish and refine playbook strategies for account expansion, executive business reviews, contract renewals, and customer risk mitigation.
* Analyze account data, customer health indicators, and market trends to forecast revenue, identify growth opportunities, and mitigate churn risk across the team's portfolio.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, team collaboration, high accountability, and customer-centricity.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5+ years of total SaaS experience, including 3+ years of direct people management experience leading Account Management or Sales teams in the enterprise+ space.
* Consistent track record of team quota achievement across net retention, cross-sell/up-sell revenue, and customer adoption targets.
* Demonstrated expertise in sales and coaching methodologies, and developing individual contributor skillsets.
* Strong leadership agility with experience operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments, and navigating complex organizational structures.
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships, including interfacing directly with executive buyers.
* Highly effective communication skills and exceptional EQ – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small.
* Strong operational and technical acumen - you have the DNA of an engineer but choose to be in sales leadership.
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

The Rare Disease Key Account Manager’s overall goal is to reduce time to diagnosis, increase appropriate patient identification and improve speed to treatment by partnering with key stakeholders in targeted accounts through focus in the therapeutic areas that Amgen's Rare Disease products are indicated. The Rare Disease Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for unlocking operational and access challenges related to appropriate therapies across assigned health systems, specialty clinics, infusion centers, and sites of care to grow the overall rare disease business in the assigned accounts and market. * Build stakeholder maps and engage clinical leaders, administrators, pharmacy, finance, revenue cycle, procurement, infusion operations, and care coordinators through proactive calls with key stakeholders
* Translate account data and insights into clear opportunity hypotheses, action plans, and performance reviews of sites.

**Clinic Contracting & Access**

* Identify and address barriers related to contracting, customer membership, ordering, distribution channel, formulary or pathway decisions, and product availability.

**Buy-and-Bill Optimization & Site Enablement**

* Engage sites of care through education, workflow support, and coordinated resources that strengthen readiness to initiate and maintain therapy.
* Help customers diagnose and identify operational gaps that can delay treatment, including referral handoffs, scheduling, infusion capacity, care coordination, and post-initiation follow-up.

* Provide timely, actionable field insights into customer needs, competitive dynamics, reimbursement trends, and operational barriers with matrix colleagues.
* Monitor account performance and adapt priorities to deliver against agreed objectives in a compliant manner.
* Maintain accurate account plans, account affiliations, activity records, and opportunity documentation in required systems.
* Lead matrix planning and follow-through for priority account initiatives, clarifying partner roles, decision points, owners, and timelines.

**Job Title:**

**Instructional Designer, Field Operations**

  

**Location:**

San Jose- Onsite

  

**Position Type:**

Full Time, Exempt

  

**Salary:**

**$85,000 - $136,000 + Benefits Day 1**

**Who We Are**
==============

Flexcar is completely reimagining car ownership. Buying a car is expensive, and leasing locks you in. So, we created a better way: flexing. Flexcar gives people their own car with one monthly payment that includes insurance, maintenance, roadside, and registration, plus the freedom to swap, keep, or return it as life changes. It's more affordable, more flexible, and more enjoyable than buying or leasing. By combining operational expertise with technology, data, and AI, we're transforming every part of the customer journey. We're scaling fast, and we're building the next generation of leaders to scale with us.

**Job Summary**
===============

The Instructional Designer owns the training that turns new hires into confident, capable operators. This person is accountable for building the new-hire onboarding curriculum, e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on exercises that teach every new employee how to do the job they were hired to do. Beyond onboarding, you will build and maintain ongoing and role-specific training, develop recurring certification and leadership development programs, deliver and support training in the field, partner with field leaders and subject-matter experts to keep content accurate as the operation evolves, and measure whether the training actually works, using completion, assessment, and on-the-job performance data to close the loop. Success in this role means new hires reach productivity faster, make fewer avoidable errors, and rate their onboarding as clear and useful.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Curriculum & Program Design**
-------------------------------

* Design and build the end-to-end new-hire onboarding curriculum for field operations roles, sequenced from first day through full productivity
* Develop e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on, job-realistic exercises that teach new hires the specific tasks of the role they were hired for
* Develop certification programs that keep field team members' skills current and verify ongoing proficiency
* Build leadership development programs that prepare high-performing operators for management roles

**Content Development & Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Produce engaging learning content in multiple formats - e-learning, video, job aids, facilitator guides, and instructor-led sessions (in person or virtual)
* Write clear, plain-language materials a new hire can follow without needing a manual or a shadow
* Build exercises and simulations that let new hires practice real tasks in a safe setting before doing them live
* Facilitate instructor-led sessions and train field leaders to deliver content consistently

**Subject-Matter Expert Partnership**
-------------------------------------

* Partner with leaders across the Operations org to capture how the job is really done and translate it into training
* Keep curriculum accurate and current as processes, tools, and vehicle-handling standards change
* Maintain a single source of truth for the standard operating procedures and job aids used in the field

**Assessment & Effectiveness**
------------------------------

* Design quizzes, skills assessments, and role certifications that verify a new hire can do the job, not just recall information
* Track completion, assessment scores, time-to-productivity, and early performance to measure whether training is working
* Use data and learner feedback to continuously improve the curriculum and close gaps

**What You Will Have**
======================

* A builder who can take a job that lives in people’s heads and turn it into clear, teachable training
* Strong instructional-design instincts - you start from what someone needs to be able to do and design backward from there
* Excellent writing and communication skills; you make complex procedures simple
* A confident facilitator, comfortable leading training in a classroom, on the floor, or virtually
* Comfortable getting out onto the floor - you learn the operation by watching it, not just reading about it
* Highly organized and self-directed, able to run multiple content projects at once and hit launch dates
* An analytical mindset - willing to measure whether training worked and change it when it didn’t
* Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-hub operation and stays close to the field

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience designing onboarding or technical training, ideally for hourly, frontline, or field-based roles; familiarity with instructional-design methods and adult-learning principles
* Hands-on experience with building e-learning content and learning management systems (LMS)
* Experience building assessments, certifications, or competency models
* Background in operations, logistics, automotive, retail, or another hands-on field environment
* Bachelor’s degree in education, communications, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience

**What Tops The Tank**
======================

* Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
* Future Savings: Benefit from a 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
* Benefits: Day One - Excellent, low-cost healthcare coverage including medical, dental, vision.

The ideal candidate will possess strong electronic repair skills, knowledge of server hardware, inventory and logistics experience, and the ability to work closely with internal teams, third-party logistics providers, field engineers, and customers. jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Federal Reserve Bank of San FranciscoWe are the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco — public servants with a mission to advance the nation’s monetary, financial, and payment systems to build a stronger economy for all Americans. As part of the nation’s central bank, we are committed to understanding and serving the vibrant, expansive communities of the Twelfth District, which covers the nine western states of the U.S. That means we seek and appreciate new perspectives and build opportunities to learn and grow. At the SF Fed, we approach our work with integrity and a commitment to service.

The SF Fed’s Supervision Group is responsible for the supervision and regulation of state member banks, bank holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, financial holding companies, data service providers, trust companies, and foreign banking organizations that operate in the 12th District. Supervised institutions are in all states of our District, and range in size and complexity from small community organizations to some of the largest banking organizations in the country.

As Supervision evolves to meet increasingly complex regulatory and industry demands, we're looking for a **Lead Business Analyst** to help lead this transformation, shifting our approach to resource and skills planning from reactive to proactive and data driven. This is a high-visibility role, partnering closely with both the Resource Management Group (RMG) and Learning & Development (L&D) teams, where forecasting models, workforce analytics, and strategic insights will directly shape how Supervision builds a stronger, more agile examiner workforce. If you enjoy translating complex data into strategic action and want your work to have a meaningful, visible impact on how the SF Fed develops the people who supervise and safeguard the financial institutions of the 12th District—advancing our mission to build a stronger economy for all Americans—we invite you to apply.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain a capacity plan and forecasting model for Supervision resources, incorporating comprehensive demand forecasts and resource modeling inputs.
* Perform scenario-based planning and modeling to produce recommendations for future needs, assess impacts of strategic initiatives and change, and provide input to tactical scheduling and resourcing plans, including training plans, based on business data and knowledge of business processes/operations.
* Lead the collection, modeling, analysis, and interpretation of complex and/or broad data; identifies and interprets trends and patterns in datasets to support resourcing recommendations or insights and drive implementation of solutions.
* Analyze complex and/or broad data sets to support decisions on future skills needs, resource planning and allocation, strategic changes, and business issues that have a broad or highly significant impact.
* Conduct skills gap analysis across the examiner workforce to identify and prioritize training investments that build a stronger, more capable Supervision team.
* Thinks strategically and can look at business solutions from both top-down and bottoms-up approach and works to creatively solve problems.
* Leads cross-functional District and System-level projects and programs related to resource planning and learning initiatives; project manages ongoing efforts including stakeholder collaboration, meeting management, document organization, and follow-ups.
* Leads team projects/programs to address business issues; manages ongoing initiatives including stakeholder collaboration, meeting management, document organization, and follow ups.
* Produce reports and analyses to monitor resource availability and usage as well as the effectiveness of key learning and development programs.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, economics, finance, accounting, or a related field is preferred.
* Typically requires eight or more years of relevant experience in strategic planning, capacity planning, resource planning, or workforce management; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proven analytical skills and problem-solving skills with experience in collecting, transforming, analyzing, and reporting complex data to drive significant business decisions.
* Experience in statistical analysis and modeling forecasts to support demand planning or capacity models within a business planning cycle with familiarity of key staffing metrics such as utilization, productivity, and attrition.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and concisely to all levels of leadership.
* Strong analytical/critical thinking skill and ability to apply sound judgment when making decisions of moderate to moderately high complexity with the ability to determine next steps in situations where information is unavailable or ambiguous.
* Prior experience leading cross-functional teams and programs across multiple stakeholder groups, with ability to drive District/System-wide initiatives from inception to execution.
* Proficient in the use of MS Office Suite (Excel), visualization software (Tableau), and programming languages such as SQL, R, Python, etc. to manipulate data and create reporting and visualizations from scratch.
* Willing and able to travel up to 10%.

jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between community members, healthcare providers, and social service organizations. Working as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod's interdisciplinary Care Team, alongside Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs, the CHW is responsible for conducting outreach, providing health education, addressing social determinants of health, and connecting members to medical, behavioral health, and community-based resources. Under the general supervision of Enhanced Care Management Leadership, the CHW works closely with members, families, care teams, and community partners to improve health outcomes, promote self-sufficiency, and reduce barriers to care; working mainly remotely alongside the Lead Care Managers for direct member engagement. This position requires strong communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and a passion for serving diverse populations.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary team member to conduct in-person visits to community members and provide education on health-related topics.

* Assist individuals in accessing healthcare services, social services, and community resources.

* Assess social determinants of health and identify barriers impacting member well-being and healthcare access.

* Support care coordination activities and collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, social workers, and community agencies.

* Function as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod Care Team, partnering closely with Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs who conduct direct member engagement.

* Accompany members to appointments when appropriate and assist with healthcare system, insurance program, and benefit enrollment navigation.

* Maintain ongoing contact with members through phone calls, home visits, community outreach, and telehealth platforms.

* Document member interactions, assessments, and referrals accurately and timely in designated systems.

* Advocate for members and assist with resolving barriers that interfere with access to care and services.

* Participate in community outreach events, health fairs, educational workshops, and engagement activities.

* Maintain member confidentiality and comply with all organizational and regulatory requirements.

* Participate in regularly scheduled member huddles for updates and feedback.

* Reporting in-person to the office as needed for meetings.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

Lycia was established in 2019 in collaboration with academic founder and Nobel Laureate Carolyn Bertozzi, Ph.D., professor of chemistry and HHMI investigator at Stanford University. In October 2026, Lycia completed an initial public offering, and its common stock now trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “LYCA.” Lycia is headquartered in South San Francisco.

Visit https://lyciatx.com/ for more information.

The Executive Assistant/Office Manager provides direct administrative support to Lycia’s Chief Business Officer, Chief Scientific Officer, and Chief Medical Officer, coordinates interviews for our hiring teams, and keeps our South San Francisco office running smoothly day to day. Working alongside Lycia’s other Executive Assistant, this role also serves on the company’s safety committee and leads the planning of our social and culture events. * Manage incoming and outgoing mail and shipments.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* A high level of discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information.
* Ability to multitask and to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities.
* Ability to work on-site in South San Francisco and to travel occasionally to support external meetings.
