jobs.title: Patient Enrollment Specialist
jobs.description:
DayaMed is seeking a motivated, personable, and results-oriented Patient Enrollment Specialist to join our growing team!

In this role, you will connect with patients referred by our partner healthcare practices, educate them about Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs, and guide interested individuals through the enrollment process.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people, communicates confidently over the phone, and thrives in a goal-oriented environment while maintaining a compassionate, patient-first approach.

Unlike traditional cold-calling positions, you will be engaging with patients who already have established relationships with our partner clinics.

Key Responsibilities

**Patient Outreach & Enrollment**

* Conduct high-volume outbound calls to eligible patients on behalf of our partner healthcare practices.
* Educate patients about RPM and CCM programs, including program benefits, participation requirements, and available support.
* Build rapport with patients, answer questions, address concerns, and help individuals make informed enrollment decisions.
* Clearly explain potential patient costs using approved and verified information.
* Obtain and accurately document patient consent in accordance with established procedures.
* Follow up with patients who need additional information or time to make an enrollment decision.

**Documentation & Coordination**

* Maintain accurate and timely records of outreach attempts, patient conversations, enrollment decisions, and follow-up activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful patient onboarding and a smooth transition into applicable programs.
* Escalate clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare professionals.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements and organizational policies.

**Performance & Accountability**

* Work toward an established goal of approximately 80–100 outbound call attempts daily.
* Target an average of 6–8 unique patient enrollments per day following an initial 30-day training and ramp-up period.
* Maintain accurate documentation and high standards of patient communication.
* Participate in ongoing training, coaching, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve patient engagement and enrollment processes.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of one year of experience in patient outreach, enrollment, customer service, call center operations, or phone-based sales.
* Excellent verbal communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain unfamiliar services clearly, accurately, and professionally.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and working toward measurable performance goals.
* Ability to accurately document information while navigating multiple computer applications.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.
* Willingness to receive feedback, participate in coaching, and contribute to team objectives.
* Commitment to protecting patient information and maintaining confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), or other healthcare enrollment programs.
* Experience communicating with Medicare beneficiaries or older adult populations.
* Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR), patient management systems, or CRM platforms.
* Experience in healthcare-related outbound calling or patient engagement.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.

What Success Looks Like

At DayaMed, we believe successful patient enrollment requires more than simply meeting a number. We value employees who can balance productivity with meaningful patient interactions.

Following an initial 30-day training and ramp-up period, performance will be evaluated using established outreach and enrollment goals, documentation accuracy, communication quality, and adherence to organizational standards.

Our priority is ensuring patients receive accurate information, understand their options, and feel supported throughout the enrollment process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

DayaMed is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Pay: $38,000.00 - $42,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

At NeuroNav, we believe everyone deserves the opportunity to make their own choices and shape their story, regardless of disability. Our mission is to enhance the quality of life for adults with developmental disabilities through simplicity and choice. We help families navigate California’s Self-Determination Program, and our team of Navigators is the heart and soul of that work.

**Work Environment: Remote**  
**Compensation: $135,000-$150,000 annually\***

Dudek’s journey began in 1980 with a vision to serve Southern California’s water and wastewater agencies.

Today, we are a 100% employee-owned firm supporting clients nationwide and delivering projects that improve and protect the built and natural environments of communities throughout the United States. Our work has been recognized by leading industry organizations, and we’ve been honored with multiple national Top Workplace Awards.

Our employee-owners are unified by a singular commitment to supporting projects that address key societal issues, such as the transition to renewable energy, infrastructure hardening and repair, environmental protection, and community resilience.

Learn more about our **award-winning culture**, the **benefits and perks** of being a Dudekian, and the **projects** you will have the opportunity to shape.

Position Overview:

**Who You Are**

As an **employee-owner**, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and **solution-oriented**, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of **innovation**.

**How** **You’ll** **Make an Impact**

Dudek is looking for a Business Operations Manager (HRIS) to provide leadership and strategic oversight for Dudek’s HR technology ecosystem, with primary responsibility for Dayforce HCM and the systems, data, integrations, and processes that support the employee lifecycle. This role will ensure HR technology is reliable, secure, well governed, scalable, and aligned with Dudek’s evolving business and workforce needs.

Working closely with Human Resources, Finance, Payroll, Benefits, IT, and other key stakeholders, the Business Operations Manager (HRIS) will serve as a critical connector between business processes and technology. The role will lead HRIS strategy and optimization, data and integration governance, system implementations and enhancements, and cross functional initiatives involving interconnected HR, ERP, financial, and enterprise systems.

The Business Operations Manager (HRIS) will also lead the HRIS team and support model, establish strong system governance and controls, and help Dudek maximize the value of its HR technology investments while supporting an effective employee and manager experience.

Candidates must be available to work during Pacific Time business hours (8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PT).

**Duties and Responsibilities**

### **HRIS Strategy & Platform Leadership**

* Leads the administration, configuration, optimization, and ongoing evolution of Dayforce HCM and Dudek’s broader HR technology ecosystem.
* Develops and maintains an HRIS roadmap aligned with HR priorities, enterprise technology initiatives, business growth, and evolving operational needs.
* Evaluates opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes through technology while balancing business requirements, user experience, system capabilities, risk, and long-term scalability.
* Maintains a strong understanding of HR technology trends, platform capabilities, and vendor roadmaps and recommends opportunities to improve Dudek’s HR technology environment.
* Establishes standards and governance for HR system configuration, enhancements, testing, releases, documentation, and change management.

### **Enterprise Systems & Integration Leadership**

* Serves as the HRIS functional lead for major enterprise technology transformations, representing HR systems, employee data, integrations, controls, and workforce process requirements in cross-functional design and implementation decisions.
* Serves as a key HRIS partner in the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of integrations between Dayforce, Deltek Vantagepoint, iCIMS, and other enterprise platforms.

jobs.title: Operations and Project Manager
jobs.description:
Loffa Interactive Group builds the software broker-dealers use to meet rules that once took a room full of people: Letters of Free Funds under Regulation T, quarterly broker statements, and prime brokerage agreements. We've done this since 2002. We're a small, fully remote company, and our clients include some of the largest firms on Wall Street.

We need one person to run our projects and our operations team. That work sits with people who are moving on to other jobs here, so you'd take it over and report to our COO.

**A year from now**

Every active project has one current plan and a named owner for each milestone. Our new platform has its first client live, and you ran the QA and go/no-go checks that got it there. The operations team brings its escalations to you. You've carried the evidence for one SOC 1 and SOC 2 audit cycle, and you've answered client vendor reviews on your own.

**What you'll do**

* Own the plan for every project. The new platform comes first. Keep dates, risks, and decisions current, and chase each open item until it has an owner and an answer.
* Run the delivery routine with our developers and QA in Jira, from sprint planning through release readiness.
* Manage the operations team. They run verification and statement work for our clients and track down counterparties when something goes wrong.
* Turn what clients and the team tell you into requirements. Our quarterly statement and prime brokerage products both started when a client described a manual process to us.
* Cover compliance about 10% of the time. You'd answer client vendor reviews and keep policies and audit evidence current. We'll teach you how we do it.
* Use AI tools every day. Ours compare a vendor questionnaire against our policies and file call notes into Jira tickets. You'd use them and make them better.

**What's hard about it**

This job doesn't work from a distance. You'd read the tickets, join the calls, and know on any given day what's stuck and why. If you'd rather oversee through status reports, it's the wrong job.

You'd also be our only project manager, with no project office behind you. And our market takes time to learn. Even with broker-dealer experience, expect months before the whole picture of how firms use our products makes sense.

**Required**

* Experience at or for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, custodian, or prime broker. Any function counts, including operations, compliance, technology, project work, or a vendor serving those firms.
* You've led a project across more than one team, from plan to delivery, as a project manager, team lead, or operations lead.
* Some hands-on time with software delivery: Jira or a similar tool, a Scrum team, or coding of any kind. A little is fine.
* Authorized to work in the United States and available during US business hours.

**Preferred**

* You've managed an operations team or directed its daily work.
* You've personally run project mechanics such as tickets, standups, user acceptance testing, trackers, or written requirements.
* Exposure to compliance work: written policies, vendor risk reviews, SOC audits, or FINRA or SEC exams.
* Experience with Letters of Free Funds, SIA-150 and SIA-151 prime brokerage agreements, or quarterly open position statements.
* A Scrum or PMP certification, SQL or scripting, FINRA licenses, or regular use of AI tools at work.

**Bonus and benefits**

You'd join our profit-sharing plan, which pays out as cash bonuses and 401(k) contributions. Your share depends on company results, your performance, and your tenure, and your title and salary don't figure into it. Profit sharing isn't guaranteed.

We also offer health insurance, a 401(k) with company matching, short-term and long-term disability coverage, paid time off that grows with tenure, and 10 paid market holidays.

The job is fully remote. We have no office to commute to, and travel is rare.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed by 4 December 2026. Include your resume, and tell us about a project you ran and what you personally did on it.

We use AI tools to help organize and compare applications. A person on our team makes every hiring decision. Offers depend on reference checks, a criminal background check, and a pre-employment drug and alcohol screen.

Loffa Interactive Group is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation to apply, email info@loffacorp.com.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked at or for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, custodian, prime broker, or a vendor serving them?
* Describe a cross-team project you led and what you personally did on it.
* Which have you used hands-on: Jira or similar, a Scrum team, SQL or code, or none?
* What base pay are you looking for?
* In a sentence or two, what does a clearing firm do that an introducing broker doesn't?

Work Location: Remote

In addition to direct project management responsibilities, this role provides portfolio management and oversight for a high-volume portfolio of smaller, repeatable projects. **POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

jobs.description:
**About Us**:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

**About The Role**:

As Lead Project Manager, Equitable Electric Mobility, you will help Catalyst Mobility drive equitable zero-emission transportation policies and programs across our priority states. This role will live within Catalyst's Innovative Mobility team, and your primary focus for the upcoming year will be managing operational and program activities within the Towards Equitable Electric Mobility (TEEM) Community of Practice, a collaborative initiative between Catalyst Mobility and The Greenlining Institute.

In this role, you will work with TEEM partners on setting strategic direction in alignment with Catalyst Mobility's broader organizational goals. You will work in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute to deliver hands-on coordination, capacity building, and peer-learning opportunities for a cohort of state-based environmental and equity organizations. You will help execute multi-state project goals, track deliverables, administer program budgets, handle reporting, and oversee efforts to attract additional funding for this work. You will ensure aligned campaign execution across state lines to build support for a national agenda for equitable electric mobility.

**What You'll Do**:

**Program Execution & Management**:

* Co-manage day-to-day TEEM cohort operations and campaign execution in close partnership with The Greenlining Institute.

* Execute clearly defined program workplans, tracking milestones and ensuring accountability across participating TEEM cohort organizations.

* Oversee program budget tracking, contract administration, and re-granting agreements to local environmental justice partners under the guidance of senior leadership with the support of the Legal and Contracts departments.

* Execute program evaluation plans, synthesizing data and collecting metrics to demonstrate program impact and inform ongoing cohort improvements.

* Coordinate cross-functional alignment between TEEM initiatives and external mobility coalitions and campaigns (e.g., Clean RIDES Network, CHARGE, Energize).

**Capacity Building & Facilitation**:

* Facilitate cohort calls, workshops, and working groups (ranging from 5 to 40+ participants) to foster relationship building, shared learning, and tactical collaboration.

* Connect state cohort organizations with relevant technical expertise, policy tools, and resources from within Catalyst Mobility and external networks.

* Assist cohort partners in establishing actionable workplans that strengthen local narrative storytelling and community support for equitable transportation policies.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Program Support**:

* Support relationship management and strategy development with key program funders, coalition leaders, and aligned national campaign partners.

* Contribute to grant proposals, narrative reporting, and funder communications in collaboration with Catalyst Mobility’s development team.

* Represent Catalyst Mobility at designated public events, coalition meetings, and conferences as a subject matter specialist in equitable electric mobility.

* Collaborate with internal teams across Catalyst Mobility, such as the Policy team, to identify operational synergies and shared opportunities.

**What You'll Bring to the Table**:

**Required Qualifications**:

* Experience: 5–7 years of professional experience in social, political, environmental, or policy campaigns with a focus on building partner capacity or coalition management.

* Program Execution: Proven track record of managing complex project timelines, tracking deliverable metrics, and keeping multi-stakeholder initiatives on schedule.

* Equity Centered Skills: Demonstrated commitment to centering belonging, justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion in your work

* Facilitation Skills: Strong group facilitation skills with experience navigating diverse coalition dynamics and building consensus across varied groups.

* Nonprofit Context: At least 2–3 years of experience operating within nonprofit organizational structures and coalition environments.

* Communication: Clear, effective written and verbal communication skills tailored for diverse audiences including community advocates, funders, and peers.

* Travel: Willingness and ability to travel periodically between TEEM target states and nationally as required (approx. 15–20%).

**Desired Qualifications**:

* Subject matter familiarity with electric transportation, clean energy, or mobility policy

* Prior experience supporting nonprofit grant proposals or funder reporting workflows.

* Geographic location within a key TEEM state (Illinois, Michigan, North Carolina, or Virginia).

* Familiarity with project management software, budget tracking tools, and modern collaborative technology stack.

Join Equum Medical and be a driving force in revolutionizing acute care telehealth. At Equum Medical, while our primary offering is innovative telehealth solutions, we recognize the critical value of bedside care. We continue to support healthcare settings where in-person, hands-on care is essential, and we are looking for strong, experienced providers who understand the importance of direct patient care.

Our telehealth platform enables healthcare professionals to deliver exceptional care remotely, bridging access gaps and enhancing patient outcomes. By joining our team, you'll have the unique opportunity to shape the future of acute care and telehealth while also having a tangible impact on patient's lives through bedside care. We offer flexible scheduling to promote work-life balance and long-term career sustainability. Together, we can redefine healthcare, providing seamless, high-quality care wherever it's needed most.

**Position Summary**:

The Project Manager for the Rural Health Transformation NY-VISTA Award is responsible for leading, coordinating, and monitoring all activities associated with the implementation of the Rural Health Transformation initiative. This position serves as the primary project management resource for the program and works collaboratively with internal leadership, clinical teams, community stakeholders, healthcare providers, government agencies, and grant partners to ensure successful achievement of program goals, deliverables, and outcomes.

The Project Manager will oversee project planning, implementation, reporting, performance measurement, and stakeholder engagement activities designed to advance healthcare access, quality, workforce development, and health equity across rural communities. This position ensures compliance with all grant requirements while maintaining project timelines, budgets, and performance metrics. *This is a 3–6-month contract to possible hire position.*

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Project Planning and Implementation**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, and workstreams aligned with NY-VISTA award objectives.
* Coordinate the execution of strategic initiatives, programs, and transformation activities across participating organizations and communities.
* Monitor project progress and identify risks, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Facilitate project meetings, workgroups, and steering committee sessions.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and in accordance with grant requirements.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a key liaison among healthcare providers, community organizations, government agencies, and external partners.
* Build collaborative relationships with rural healthcare stakeholders to support program success.
* Coordinate communications and provide regular project updates to leadership and funding entities.
* Facilitate stakeholder feedback processes and incorporate recommendations into project planning.

**Grant Compliance and Reporting**

* Maintain compliance with all grant terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
* Track project outcomes, performance measures, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Prepare and submit required reports, presentations, and progress updates.
* Assist with audits, site visits, and documentation requests from funding agencies.

**Data Analysis and Performance Management**

* Collect, analyze, and interpret project data to evaluate effectiveness and progress toward goals.
* Develop dashboards and tracking tools to monitor outcomes and program performance.
* Identify trends and recommend process improvements based on data findings.
* Support continuous quality improvement initiatives and outcome evaluation activities.

**Budget and Resource Management**

* Monitor project expenditures and ensure appropriate use of grant funding.
* Coordinate resource allocation and project support activities.
* Assist leadership in budget forecasting and financial reporting.
* Work collaboratively with finance and operational teams to maintain fiscal accountability.

**Strategic Growth & Sustainability**

* Partner with commercial and operational teams to identify opportunities to expand Rural Health Transformation initiatives and support organizational growth.
* Lead sustainability planning, including Year 2+ strategy development, funding diversification, and long-term program viability.
* Coordinate grant development activities, including funding opportunity identification, application management, and proposal support.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Program Expansion**

* Develop and execute engagement strategies to increase participation among existing healthcare partners and stakeholders.
* Coordinate outreach, communications, and educational content to promote awareness and adoption of Rural Health Transformation programs.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner engagement and participation through targeted communications and collaborative planning.

**Requirements**:

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Project Management, Communications, or a related field.
* Minimum of three (3) years of project management experience, preferably in healthcare, public health, rural health, community development, or grant-funded programs.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent credential, preferred.
* Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional teams and stakeholder collaborations.
* Experience with federally or state-funded grant programs, preferred.
* Knowledge of rural healthcare systems, population health, and healthcare transformation initiatives, preferred.
* Experience with performance improvement and quality management methodologies.

Maximus is currently seeking a Senior Project Manager - AI Strategy.
  
  
This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Capital Markets
jobs.description:
Terrion, Inc. is an advanced carbon materials company building a fully domestic production pathway for synthetic graphite and graphene. Our patent-pending Carbonyx™ process converts purchased Pennsylvania anthracite into three co-produced materials, synthetic graphite powder, high-density fine-grain graphite blocks, and graphene, using a single integrated process rather than three separate supply chains.

Graphite is a designated critical material. The United States imports the overwhelming majority of the synthetic graphite it consumes, and domestic capacity is limited. Terrion exists to change that. We are venture-backed and part of the IBX family of companies. Terrion operates an active research and development laboratory in Gaithersburg, Maryland, is building out a pilot production facility near Frederick, and will build commercial manufacturing facilities at sites now being selected. We are executing federally funded programs, including work under an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA), to build production capability and deliver against government milestones.

Terrion is at the transition point between demonstrated science and manufactured product. That transition is a delivery problem, not a research problem. This role exists to execute it, first at the pilot plant and then at commercial scale.

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Project Manager, Capital Projects, is Terrion's on-site owner of capital project delivery. The role first leads the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, from construction and equipment installation through commissioning and operational readiness, against schedules and milestones set by Terrion's federally funded programs. As Terrion moves to commercial scale, the role then leads delivery of the first commercial plant, which is expected to be a substantially larger facility at a site still being selected.

This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory layer above a controls staff. The Senior Project Manager personally builds and maintains the project schedule, cost baseline, and risk register using tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or Excel, and is Terrion's day-to-day point of accountability for the construction, engineering, and vendor partners on each project. Technical design and engineering decisions sit with the Director of Engineering and Terrion's technical leads. This role owns the schedule, budget, coordination, and delivery around them.

**What You Will Do**

**Pilot Facility Build-Out and Commissioning**

* Lead the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, serving as Terrion's on-site project lead from construction through equipment installation, commissioning, and turnover to operations

* Hold Terrion's construction project manager, general contractor, architects, outside engineering firm, and trade contractors accountable to committed dates, including recovery planning when schedules slip

* Coordinate permitting, occupancy, and utility readiness with local authorities, and work with the environmental, safety, and health lead to keep the site compliant with state and local requirements

* Drive long-lead capital equipment procurement to schedule, tracking vendors, purchase orders, lead times, delivery, installation sequencing, and warranty terms, based on specifications developed by the Director of Engineering

* Integrate design, layout, utility, and regulatory requirements across the project so decisions are made with the full site picture in view

* Be on site daily once construction is underway

**Commercial Plant Delivery**

* Lead project delivery for Terrion's first commercial manufacturing plant, carrying lessons from the pilot facility into the commercial schedule, budget, and contracting approach

* Establish the integrated schedule, cost baseline, and contractor and vendor structure for the commercial plant, and travel to the site as construction and commissioning require

* Support site selection, proposal development, and capital planning with schedule basis, basis of estimate, and staffing plans

**Schedule, Cost, and Risk Control**

* Build and maintain the integrated schedule and cost baseline for each project, including budget development, commitment and accrual tracking, variance analysis, estimate at completion, and resource-loading to the work package level

* Administer scope, schedule, and cost changes through a formal change-control process

* Maintain a risk register with a named owner and mitigation plan for each risk, and report top risks and status during program reviews

* Prepare milestone evidence packages, monthly technical and financial reports, and quarterly program reviews, and report regularly on schedule, cost, progress, risks, and required decisions

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate functional leads across engineering, quality, safety, environmental and health, supply chain, procurement, finance, and operations

* Run the project operating cadence, coordinate with company leadership on agreement administration and flow-down obligations, and escalate schedule, cost, resource, or performance issues early enough to allow corrective action

* Help establish the project management processes, tools, and systems a growing company needs to manage capital projects, track deliverables, and report performance

**What You Bring**

We are targeting project managers with 10 or more years of experience delivering hardware, equipment, facilities, or manufactured products against a customer's contract requirements. The strongest candidates have carried a capital expansion, new production line, new facility, or contract production program from plan to delivery, and can describe what slipped, why, and what they did about it.

* Approximately 10 or more years of career experience, with a core focus on leading complex engineering, capital, or industrial manufacturing projects

* Direct responsibility for sizable projects or programs (ideally $10 million or more in total

**About CCI**

Complete Compliance, Inc. (CCI), based in Omaha, Nebraska, provides compliance, audit, and information technology consulting services to community banks nationwide. We help financial institutions understand regulatory requirements, strengthen internal programs, manage risk, and prepare for regulatory examinations.

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to keep client engagements, internal processes, and project workflows organized, current, and moving forward.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports CCI’s audit, compliance, and information technology functions and provides administrative and project coordination support to the Operations & Marketing Manager and President. The role maintains workflow and recordkeeping systems, tracks engagement progress, coordinates projects, supports company publications, and follows organizational priorities from initiation through completion.

The ideal candidate is organized, initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a professional services environment. Candidates should have strong proofreading and communication skills and a willingness to learn banking, compliance, audit, and regulatory concepts.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Audit & Project Coordination**

* Support audit engagement scheduling, prioritization, and deadlines.
* Maintain audit tracking system and engagement status reports.
* Manage audit request lists and document collection processes.
* Organize engagement files and supporting documentation.

**Report Review & Publication Management**

* Review audit reports for formatting, grammar, consistency, completeness, and adherence to established report procedures.
* Track report revisions and review comments.
* Serve as editor of CCI Updates and other company publications.
* Maintain report review procedures and quality control checklists.

**Records & Document Management**

* Maintain engagement files, contracts, and supporting documentation.
* Create and maintain SharePoint and ShareFile engagement folders.
* Manage records retention and engagement archiving.
* Verify documentation is properly retained and organized.

**Tracking & Operational Support**

* Record and track audit data.
* Track engagement metrics, deadlines, and project status.
* Assist management with workload planning and operational reporting.
* Maintain the firm's centralized audit citation database and related reporting.

**Administrative & Executive Support**

jobs.title: Care Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nox Health**

Simply put, we believe in the power of sleep.

As sleep health champions, we want more and more people to wake up to a brighter day every day. And, we are making daily progress, as we help more organizations see sleep as transformational and a foundational pillar of health. We strive to give more access to the technology and care they need to lead fuller lives.

Our depth of knowledge in the science of sleep gives us a unique perspective on sleep as a critical intervention strategy in chronic disease. We help people see the right problem and the right way forward, elevating not just our solutions but also advancing the field of sleep medicine.

Our vision is to work with our partners — employers, health systems, health plans, government agencies, provider groups and others committed to transforming care — to expand sleep health care to where it is needed, so it can take its rightful place in the healthcare ecosystem.

**About the role**

The Care Manager is a valued member of the Nox Health team, helping patients successfully navigate their sleep apnea treatment journey. This role provides personalized education, coaching, and ongoing support to help patients become comfortable with their Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) therapy, overcome treatment challenges, and achieve long-term success.

This is a proactive, relationship-focused role where you will independently manage an assigned caseload, monitor therapy adherence, and help patients meet insurance compliance requirements. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, compassionate, and organized, with the ability to build meaningful patient relationships while meeting performance goals in a fast-paced environment.

**Work Schedule & Location:** This is a remote position. The work schedule is Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM – 9:00 PM ET, with occasional Saturdays required.

**What you'll do**

* Manage an assigned caseload of patients, providing proactive outreach, education, and ongoing support throughout their PAP therapy journey.
* Educate patients on proper PAP equipment use, maintenance, and troubleshooting to improve comfort and treatment success.
* Build strong patient relationships through active listening, motivational interviewing, and personalized coaching to overcome barriers to therapy.
* Monitor PAP therapy adherence, identify patients at risk of noncompliance, and provide timely interventions to help meet insurance requirements.
* Independently prioritize patient outreach, follow-ups, and daily responsibilities while maintaining a high level of patient care.
* Manage a high volume of patient interactions while meeting established KPIs related to productivity, patient engagement, and therapy compliance.
* Accurately document patient interactions, treatment progress, and follow-up activities within the KOEO platform.
* Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to resolve patient concerns and escalate issues as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, clinical experience, or customer service experience, preferably in healthcare.
* Knowledge of PAP therapy, equipment use, and common troubleshooting techniques; sleep medicine experience preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to educate, motivate, and build trust with patients.
* Self-motivated and independent, with strong initiative, accountability, and follow-through.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment.
* Strong computer proficiency, including the ability to navigate multiple systems and accurately document information while speaking with patients.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Experience with motivational interviewing, patient coaching, or care management preferred.
* Ability to maintain a dedicated, private, and quiet workspace to ensure patient confidentiality and conduct professional, uninterrupted patient conversations.

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
20 - 22 USD per hour(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Senior Information Assurance Analyst / Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC**

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC, we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

**Location:** This is a US-based remote position, with occasional on-site visits to Arlington, VA as required (travel at employee's expense).

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Security Clearance:** No security clearance required. Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Job Summary**
---------------

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking a Senior Information Assurance (IA) Analyst / Program Manager to support the Headquarters, Department of the Army G-1, Directorate of Prevention, Resilience, and Readiness (DPRR) Information Assurance Support Services (IASS) program. This key personnel role leads the Information Assurance program for the Drug and Alcohol Management Information System (DAMIS), the Risk Reduction Unit Risk Inventory Application, and associated standalone applications hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud. Serving as the Information Assurance Security Officer (IASO) and the Contracting Officer Representative's (COR) main point of contact, this position owns Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) maintenance and reauthorization, and supervises the IA Analyst. Core hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the overall Information Assurance program for DAMIS under the direction of the System Owner/COR and the Program Information Systems Security Manager (P-ISSM), serving as IASO and the COR's main point of contact.
* Manage the system's Risk Management Framework (RMF) process; prepare, coordinate, and submit security documentation for review and routing to the approving authority, and adapt to changing requirements from TBAI, Army CIO, or DoW.
* Use the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) to obtain and maintain the system ATO; perform weekly continuous monitoring of ATO requirements, STIGs, and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) and report weekly ATO status with a remediation plan.
* Develop and maintain the RMF modernization and timeline plan with ATO milestones, and prepare and submit the ATO reauthorization package in eMASS before the current ATO expires.
* Manage the vulnerability compliance report and lead annual contingency, security, and recovery tests, submitting documentation within 2 business days of test completion.
* Prepare FISMA-compliant reports and update information assurance data in the Army Portfolio Management System (APMS), Army Asset & Vulnerability Tracking Resource (A&VTR), and eMASS.
* Prepare and submit the Monthly Status Report (MSR) on RMF compliance, challenges, issues, and prior-month activity.
* Serve as a member of the agency's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT), acknowledging incidents within 15 minutes and initiating approved mitigation within one hour during duty hours; maintain the Emergency Operations Plan.
* Review system change requests and recommend implementation or alternatives based on IA vulnerabilities within 2 business days.
* Attend IA working groups, conferences, and recurring meetings virtually or in person, and provide minutes and recommendations within 2 business days.
* Supervise the IA Analyst, review deliverables for quality, and provide backup coverage for IA Analyst tasks.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* At least 6 years of technical and compliance experience maintaining a system's security posture and managing security within a Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environment.
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams.
* Proven IA/cybersecurity experience managing the security posture of systems involving .NET, Windows, Azure, Oracle, and Red Hat.
* Strong background in data architecture, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Red Hat and Windows security and administration.
* Extensive experience implementing and auditing against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists to oversee RMF processes and continuous monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a system's ATO and obtain a new ATO.
* Experience using eMASS.
* Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.
* Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation prior to start.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ACAS, SCAP Compliance Checker, and DISA STIG Viewer.
* Experience supporting systems through RMF changes such as the transition from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 to Revision 5.
* Experience supporting Army systems hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud.
* Experience with systems handling Privacy Act, PII, or HIPAA-protected data.
* Experience with FISMA reporting in APMS and A&VTR.

**Certifications**
------------------

* Active Tier 3 (NACI) or higher background investigation prior to start.
* DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, GSLC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment.
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment. CISSP satisfies both IAM Level II and IAT Level II.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Opportunity**
--------------------------

At JDA TSG, we continuously partner with leading enterprise SaaS and technology brands to build and scale high-performing Customer Success organizations. Because our client partnerships and program scopes expand frequently, we proactively maintain an active candidate pipeline for Customer Success Manager roles across multiple account tiers. **This is an evergreen posting designed to connect with top-tier talent for upcoming and immediate openings.** By applying, you allow our talent team to evaluate your profile now so we can move quickly with pre-aligned candidates as new client roles launch.

### **Role Summary**

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will serve as the dedicated advisor and post-sales owner for a portfolio of business accounts across varied industries. We believe long-term client retention isn't achieved through quick support tickets; it relies on proactive relationship building, root-cause problem solving, and driving ongoing platform utilization. By understanding client business goals, guiding onboarding, and coordinating internal teams to remove adoption barriers, your work protects account health, drives product utilization, and maximizes customer lifetime value.

* **Portfolio Management & Value Realization:** You will manage a designated book of client accounts, conducting regular business reviews and connecting platform features directly to the client’s core business outcomes. Success is measured by gross revenue retention, portfolio health score movement, and client satisfaction (CSAT) ratings.
* **Proactive Risk Mitigation & Adoption Tracking:** You will monitor customer usage trends, identify early churn or health decay signals, and execute intervention plans before account health deteriorates. Success is measured by churn reduction, rapid resolution of adoption stalls, and account health stability.
* **Expansion Advocacy & Cross-Functional Leadership:** You will identify organic growth opportunities during routine customer touchpoints and collaborate with internal product, support, and sales teams to resolve complex client challenges. Success is measured by qualified lead generation for expansion, account renewals, and seamless cross-functional resolution.

  

* At least 2 to 5 years of experience in a customer-facing Customer Success, Account Management, or consultative client engagement role within B2B environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing a client portfolio, with a clear understanding of retention metrics, engagement cadences, and priority management.
* Consultative discovery skills to diagnose root causes of operational friction rather than defaulting to quick ticket resolution.
* Proven track record of influencing customer behavior, removing software adoption barriers, and tying ongoing product usage directly to client ROI.
* Ability to recognize early churn or health decay signals from usage data and execute a proactive retention plan.

jobs.title: Growth and Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
\*\*Growth and Customer Success Lead (Founding Role)\*\*

Agiletech· [Remote, US only] · Hourly -commission

**Getting subscriptions and Revenue, That is this job.**

We developed an AI agent for small business's website. It answers customer questions only from that business's own content, cites every reply, and says "I don't know" instead of guessing. The same chat takes online orders from the business's own menu or catalog, runs a kitchen display for restaurants, books appointments and captures leads. Our customers are restaurants, clinics, salons, trades, online stores and support teams: owners who answer the same questions all day and don't have a developer.

We are early. The product is broad and live, and the next step is getting it into the hands of the businesses it was built for.

This is a very fast paced Work, apply only if you are up for it.

\*\*The role\*\*

You will be the first person whose whole job is customers: finding them, signing them up, getting them live and keeping them happy. You will own the path from a stranger hearing about us to a business that pays every month and tells another owner. You will work directly with the founder and have real influence over the product, pricing and what we build next.

\*\*What you'll do\*\*

\*Marketing and visibility\*

- Run our launch and directory listings: Product Hunt, G2, Capterra and the AI and industry directories.

- Write and publish two articles a month for owners, from a keyword plan we already have.

- Build our presence where buyers are, such as restaurant, clinic and e-commerce communities, LinkedIn, Reddit and local business groups, by being useful first.

- Test small paid search campaigns per industry, and stop what doesn't produce trials.

\*Bringing in subscribers\*

- Reach out to restaurants, clinics, salons and stores, show them what their own website can't answer, and run short demos.

- Personally set up the first customers: upload their menu, get the chat on their site, and print their QR code.

- Turn early customers into case studies, reviews and referrals.

\*Growing revenue\*

- Own trial-to-paid conversion. Find where trials stall and fix it with onboarding emails, in-app guidance and timely follow-up.

- Move customers to annual billing, and to higher plans when they outgrow theirs.

- Run launch offers and promotions with our built-in promotional pricing.

- Bring pricing feedback from real conversations to the founder.

\*Supporting customers and the product\*

- Answer support questions by email and chat, with a goal of same-day replies.

- Help owners with setup: menus, ordering, the kitchen display, bookings and the chat widget.

- Keep the FAQ, guides and help articles accurate as the product changes.

- Bring every bug, confusion and feature request back to the product, with the customer's own words attached.

\*\*What success looks like\*\*

- \*\*First 30 days.\*\* You know the product end to end, the directory listings are live, and you have set up your first customers by hand. You have a repeatable way of bringing in trials, a trial-to-paid rate we trust, published case studies, and a support process that doesn't depend on the founder.

- \*\*First year.\*\* You own a growing revenue line and know which channel produces customers at what cost.

\*\*You might be a fit if you\*\*

- Have 3+ years in B2B SaaS growth, customer success, account management or sales, ideally selling to small businesses.

- Can explain a technical product in plain words to a restaurant owner during a lunch rush.

- Write clearly and quickly, from a cold email to a help article to a launch post.

- Are comfortable picking up the phone, walking into a business, and running a demo.

- Look at numbers weekly and change course when something isn't working.

- Like owning an outcome end to end more than owning one slice of it.

\*\*Nice to have\*\*

- Experience with restaurants, hospitality, clinics or e-commerce, or with POS, ordering or booking software.

- SEO and content experience, or a track record with Product Hunt or directory launches.

- Familiarity with Stripe, HubSpot or a similar CRM, and analytics tools.

- Spanish or another second language. Many of our owners and their customers speak more than one.

\*\*How to apply\*\*

Send your resume and a short note to agiletechinc1@gmail.com answering one question: pick a local business near you and tell us what three questions their website doesn't answer. There's no wrong answer. We want to see how you think about a customer.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 28.0 per week

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Scope of the Job:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is seeking its first Sales Enablement Manager to build our sales enablement function from the ground up. As we refine our brand, product story, and approach to selling, this person will help our sellers clearly explain who we are, what we offer, the customer problems we solve, and how to sell our solutions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set priorities and create the content and training to deliver them. Working closely with Revenue Leadership, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and technical experts, you will investigate gaps, bring the right people together, and turn complex information into practical sales resources. You should be comfortable asking difficult questions, constructively challenging assumptions, and following through to get the information and decisions sellers need.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain a practical sales enablement roadmap and playbook, prioritizing the most urgent seller needs with Revenue Leadership.
* Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training covering company and product knowledge, customer use cases, discovery, qualification, demos, and value conversations. Use practice and feedback to assess seller readiness.
* Create and maintain sales presentations, product and use case guides, discovery questions, objection handling, and competitive battle cards. Organize approved resources so sellers can easily find current materials.
* Learn QCi’s products, subsidiaries, target customers, and selling motions through interviews with experts, sales conversations, and existing materials. Partner with Marketing to translate the evolving brand and positioning into clear sales messaging, validated by Product and technical teams.
* Support product launches with seller training, messaging, FAQs, and sales tools. Surface unclear product scope, capabilities, availability, or claims and drive follow-up with the accountable owners before communicating them to sellers.
* Measure adoption, knowledge and skill development, and seller feedback. Partner with Sales Operations and sales leaders to assess business impact and improve programs.
* Coordinate subject matter experts, clarify owners and deadlines, and escalate unresolved dependencies with a clear recommendation. Product and leadership retain ownership of product definition and commercial readiness; Marketing retains ownership of brand and positioning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in sales enablement, product marketing, sales training, or a related commercial role, with direct ownership of enablement deliverables. Equivalent experience demonstrating the capabilities below will also be considered.
* Demonstrated experience building an enablement program, playbook, or onboarding approach from an early stage, including personally creating materials and delivering training.
* Strong writing, facilitation, and project management skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, accurate customer value and practical sales guidance.
* Ability to work independently amid incomplete information, influence stakeholders without formal authority, ask probing questions, and persist constructively to secure input and resolve blockers. Strong commercial curiosity and the ability to understand customer needs, buying processes, and how sellers move opportunities forward

**Additional Preferred Skills:**

* Experience supporting B2B technology or complex technical sales. Exposure to quantum, photonics, semiconductors, AI, or other deep technology is helpful; prior quantum expertise is not required.
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems and practical approaches to organizing and maintaining enablement content.
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing, Product, and technical teams in an organization with evolving products or multiple selling motions.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to Level Up?  
Join our growing team as a Support Operations Specialist  
  
**About the role**  
You will own the systems, reporting, and knowledge that keep Track's Customer Support team running smoothly. Reporting to the Support Operations Manager, you will partner with Support Leadership, Product, and Engineering to tune Zendesk, build the dashboards our leaders rely on, and grow our AI and self-service tools. As our support team scales, this role exists to make every ticket easier to solve, or better yet, never needed. This is a remote, full-time role with about 10% travel.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Keep Zendesk running clean by tuning views, macros, triggers, automations, and routing so tickets land in the right hands the first time.
* Build dashboards that track ticket volume, backlog, response and resolution times, SLA performance, and CSAT, and flag trends before they turn into problems.
* Find the manual work slowing the team down and remove it through better workflows, automation, or documentation.
* Own the knowledge base so customers and agents find answers fast, writing and updating internal and external articles and troubleshooting guides across Track's products.
* Configure, test, and improve our AI support tools and chatbots, keeping content AI-ready and driving up ticket deflection and self-service adoption.
* Build onboarding and ongoing training for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support so new agents ramp faster and stay current on product changes.
* Partner with Tier 3, Product, and Engineering to document known issues, defects, and workarounds, and keep user access across support tools accurate.

**What you will bring**  

* 2+ years in customer support, support operations, or technical enablement at a SaaS or technology company.
* Hands-on admin experience with Zendesk or a similar platform, including views, macros, triggers, automations, routing, and reporting.
* Real experience implementing and optimizing AI-powered support tools, chatbots, or self-service solutions that reduced support volume.
* A track record of writing knowledge base articles, technical documentation, or training content that turns complex topics into clear, actionable steps.
* Solid command of support operations and metrics, including SLAs, escalation paths, and defect tracking, and the ability to use data to recommend process changes.
* Working knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, or Salesforce.

**You will thrive here if**  

* You see the same ticket come in a third time and can't help but build the article, macro, or automation that stops it from coming back.
* You like being the connector between Support, Product, and Engineering, and you will chase down the details on a defect until the workaround is documented and the team knows about it.

**Compensation**  
The expected starting base salary range for this role is $38.46 - $43.27 per hour, plus eligibility for a 10% annual incentive tied to company performance. Final compensation is based on relevant skills, experience, education, and geographic location.  
  
**About Track**  
Track is an end-to-end SaaS and Service Operating Platform for short term rental. For more than two decades we have helped hospitality professionals achieve digital transformation and operational excellence, anchored by our flagship Track Property Management System.  
  
Our single-vendor ecosystem gives growing vacation rental companies the enterprise-class tools they need to scale, backed by 70+ integration partners, a growing suite of native features, and AI-driven tools that sharpen pricing, distribution, and guest communication. We combine deep hospitality expertise with forward-thinking technology and a customer-obsessed mindset to help property managers win.  
  
Track is proud to be named an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company in America and a People's Choice Award winner.  
  
**Our core values**  
These are the behaviors that shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our customers.  

* Serve Others: nurturing growth to help others succeed
* Grit: taking ownership and never giving up on what matters most
* Create the Future: innovating to disrupt the status quo

**Benefits and perks**  

* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible paid time off
* Health Savings Account with up to a $2,000 annual match, plus Flexible Spending Accounts
* Up to $900 a year in Wellness Rewards
* Retirement plan with employer match
* Unlimited access to professional training and development
* Company-paid life insurance and long-term disability coverage
* Flexible work environment, plus a $150 quarterly gift for personal use

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
We celebrate diversity of thought, culture, and background and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law. We comply with all applicable laws governing nondiscrimination in every location where we operate and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or interview process, contact HR@trackhospitality.com and we will work with you.

jobs.title: Client Success and Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT GOSHEN AND THIS ROLE**

Goshen Accounting Services is a small, fully remote firm that serves as the finance team for nonprofit organizations. We handle fund accounting, grant compliance, audit preparation, Form 990s, and fractional CFO work for organizations whose missions matter to us.

We are looking for a Client Success and Operations Specialist to be the steady, clear voice our clients hear between the numbers. You will own day-to-day client communication and coordination, make sound judgment calls within defined limits, and know when a matter needs Goshen's Senior Manager.

This is not a calendar-and-inbox role. We need someone who can read a situation, decide what it calls for, and write a message a client can act on without needing to ask a follow-up question.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* **Client communication:** Respond to client emails and requests that need judgment, in clear, warm, and professional writing on Goshen's behalf.
* **Deliverable coordination:** Track every client deadline, including month-end closes, board packages, audit requests, and filings, and keep our bookkeeping partner on schedule.
* **Document compliance and risk monitoring:** Review client document submissions for completeness and compliance, so we have everything needed to update financial records and manage grants. Follow up on missing items and flag client concerns, scope changes, or deadline risks to Goshen's Senior Manager before they become problems.
* **Firm operations:** Handle client onboarding paperwork, document collection, and the operational follow-through that keeps client work moving. Manage the firm's expenses and support the recruitment process for our accounting team.
* **Cross-team coordination:** Work alongside leadership, business development, client account owners, and our billing, payables, and receivables functions to resolve issues and keep deliverables on track.
* **Client onboarding and systems training:** Help bring new clients on board, support the rollout of the systems and tools we implement for them, and train and coach their staff to use those tools with confidence.
* **Judgment within clear limits:** You will work from a written decision-rights list that spells out what you decide alone, what you decide and report, and what you escalate first. Your authority grows as you show sound judgment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

**You must have:**

* At least 5 years in a client-facing coordination or client service role at an accounting firm, or in a similar role communicating directly with executive leaders such as CEOs, executive directors, and CFOs.
* Written communication that is clear on the first read. Your messages lead with the point, make one specific request, and name who does what by when.
* Strong comfort with technology. You learn new software quickly, troubleshoot issues on your own, and can teach others to use a tool step by step. This includes a strong working command of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Gmail, and of CRM and database platforms.
* A problem-solving mindset. When something is stuck, you find the cause, propose a fix, and follow through rather than waiting to be told.
* Professional, warm communication by phone and video as well as in writing, with a client-first mindset and genuine empathy for clients working under pressure.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail; manage your time well, and keep several priorities moving at once in a fast-paced environment.
* Examples of decisions you made on your own, and of times you recognized something was above your authority and escalated it.
* Comfort with accounting deadlines and terms (month-end close, audit, grant reporting) well enough to spot risk. You do not need to do the accounting.
* Experience working remotely and independently, with little day-to-day supervision.
* Respect for confidentiality, including sensitive client and HR information.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with Asana, QuickBooks Online, or similar tools.
* Experience coordinating work with an outsourced team or vendor.

**HOW WE WORK**

* Async first. We work mostly in writing, through Asana and email, with documented processes and standard operating procedures. You will rarely wait for a meeting to move work forward.
* High standards. Our firm holds a 98% accuracy standard, and we expect the same care in client communication.
* Room to grow. Your decision-making authority expands at set review points as you show sound judgment.
* Schedule: This role starts part-time at 20 hours per week, with availability during our business hours. Hours will grow as our client base and capacity needs increase.

**HOW TO APPLY**

* Your resume.
* Your written answer to our given scenario in 150 words or fewer.

Pay: $27.00 - $36.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) 3% Match
* Internet reimbursement
* Professional development assistance
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Scenario: At 4:00 p.m. on a Friday, a nonprofit's executive director emails: "Our board meets Monday. Please send updated financials over the weekend." Our bookkeeping team says the month-end close will not be finished until Wednesday. Write the reply you would send to the executive director, then add one or two sentences on what you would do next and why.

Experience:

* client-facing coordination or client service: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial construction projects, including tenant improvements, renovations, and specialized construction within the life sciences, healthcare, technology, and education sectors.

This position will be responsible for managing all aspects of construction projects, from preconstruction and estimating through project execution and final closeout. The Project Manager will oversee budgets, schedules, subcontractors, contracts, and client relationships while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

* Strong experience with commercial tenant improvements, renovations, or specialized construction projects.
* Experience managing projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Proven ability to manage project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, and client relationships.

* Knowledge of commercial construction trades, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.
* Experience managing RFIs, submittals, change orders, and construction documentation.

========================

----------------------------------

* Design, build and optimize HPC clusters across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.

* Translate the HPC roadmap into technical designs, implementation plans and working solutions.

* Evaluate and run proof-of-concepts for new HPC, GPU and cloud technologies, and share technical recommendations.

* Define and follow technical standards, reference architectures and best practices for HPC environments.

**Technical Requirement Analysis & Solutioning**
------------------------------------------------

* Work with engineering, R&D and AI/ML users to understand workload, application and performance requirements.

* Turn requirements into technical designs, cluster configurations and deployment approaches.

* Conduct technical feasibility assessments, design reviews and benchmarking for new HPC use cases.

* Act as the senior technical point of contact for HPC-related issues and solutions.

----------------------

* Design and support GPU-accelerated infrastructure for AI/ML training and inference workloads.

* Tune GPU clusters, drivers, CUDA libraries and containers for performance and stability.

* Work with AI/ML teams to optimize job scheduling, resource allocation and data pipelines.

* Explore and prototype Generative AI and emerging technologies on HPC platforms.

**Cloud HPC & Platform Management**
-----------------------------------

* Implement and maintain cloud HPC solutions on Azure, AWS and other providers.

* Configure and manage HPC platforms such as Rescale, Azure CycleCloud, Slurm and related tools.

* Automate cluster provisioning and configuration using infrastructure-as-code and scripting.

* Ensure HPC environments meet security, compliance and business continuity requirements.

* Monitor cloud resource usage and recommend technical cost optimizations.

**Operations, Performance & Support**
-------------------------------------

* Act as the highest-level escalation point for complex HPC incidents and troubleshooting.

* Perform performance tuning, benchmarking and capacity analysis for compute, storage and network.

* Drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.

* Contribute to change management, patching, upgrades and platform reliability improvements.

* Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles.

**Technical Guidance & Collaboration**
--------------------------------------

* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to HPC engineers and support staff.

* Conduct code, configuration and design reviews.

* Work with vendors and cloud providers on technical issues, product evaluations and escalations.

* Coordinate with infrastructure, storage, networking, security and application teams on technical delivery.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in HPC engineering, infrastructure or architecture roles.

* 2+ years of experience in a technical lead or senior engineer role.

* Strong hands-on knowledge of:

* HPC cluster design, deployment and administration

* Linux system administration and performance tuning

* Slurm or equivalent HPC workload schedulers

* MPI and parallel application environments

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and communication skills.

**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Live**  
**What you will do**

The Rare Disease Key Account Manager’s overall goal is to reduce time to diagnosis, increase appropriate patient identification and improve speed to treatment by partnering with key stakeholders in targeted accounts through focus in the therapeutic areas that Amgen's Rare Disease products are indicated. The Rare Disease Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for unlocking operational and access challenges related to appropriate therapies across assigned health systems, specialty clinics, infusion centers, and sites of care to grow the overall rare disease business in the assigned accounts and market. The KAM diagnoses account-level barriers and executes targeted strategies that enable appropriate access to therapy, strengthen clinic readiness, optimize buy-and-bill operations, and support a reliable patient and customer experience across the rare disease treatment journey.

**Responsibilities:**

**Account Strategy & Enterprise Value**

* Proactively assess the business environment across assigned accounts to identify access, operational, economic, and care-delivery barriers that affect appropriate rare disease therapy utilization, reducing time to diagnosis and time to treatment .
* Develop and execute account plans and identify Amgen portfolio objectives aligned to customer priorities, including addressing portfolio growth, patient access, site-of-care friction, and treatment continuity.
* Build stakeholder maps and engage clinical leaders, administrators, pharmacy, finance, revenue cycle, procurement, infusion operations, and care coordinators through proactive calls with key stakeholders
* Translate account data and insights into clear opportunity hypotheses, action plans, and performance reviews of sites.

**Clinic Contracting & Access**

* Serve as the commercial lead for assigned account contracting opportunities, coordinating internal approvals and supporting compliant negotiation and execution.
* Identify and address barriers related to contracting, customer membership, ordering, distribution channel, formulary or pathway decisions, and product availability.
* Partner with market access, pricing, trade, reimbursement, and legal/compliance colleagues to support durable access solutions.
* Support account business reviews that assess contract performance, patient access, operational readiness, and appropriate commercial opportunities.

**Buy-and-Bill Optimization & Site Enablement**

* Evaluate buy-and-bill workflows, including acquisition, inventory, benefit verification, prior authorization, coding, billing, payment, and financial risk points.
* Work with clinics and internal partners to identify practical improvements in reimbursement readiness, inventory practices, ordering processes, and patient financial navigation.
* Engage sites of care through education, workflow support, and coordinated resources that strengthen readiness to initiate and maintain therapy.
* Help customers diagnose and identify operational gaps that can delay treatment, including referral handoffs, scheduling, infusion capacity, care coordination, and post-initiation follow-up.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Insights**

* Coordinate field execution with sales, medical, patient services, market access, trade, analytics, and brand partners.
* Provide timely, actionable field insights into customer needs, competitive dynamics, reimbursement trends, and operational barriers with matrix colleagues.
* Monitor account performance and adapt priorities to deliver against agreed objectives in a compliant manner.
* Maintain accurate account plans, account affiliations, activity records, and opportunity documentation in required systems.
* Lead matrix planning and follow-through for priority account initiatives, clarifying partner roles, decision points, owners, and timelines.

**Win**

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 2 years of sales experience and/or related account management experience

OR

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of sales experience and/or related account management experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of sales experience and/or related account management experience

OR

High School diploma/GED and 12 years of sales experience and/or related account management experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with complex provider accounts, specialty clinics, health syste
