new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:**

**Instructional Designer, Field Operations**

  

**Location:**

San Jose- Onsite

  

**Position Type:**

Full Time, Exempt

  

**Salary:**

**$85,000 - $136,000 + Benefits Day 1**

**Who We Are**
==============

Flexcar is completely reimagining car ownership. Buying a car is expensive, and leasing locks you in. So, we created a better way: flexing. Flexcar gives people their own car with one monthly payment that includes insurance, maintenance, roadside, and registration, plus the freedom to swap, keep, or return it as life changes. It's more affordable, more flexible, and more enjoyable than buying or leasing. By combining operational expertise with technology, data, and AI, we're transforming every part of the customer journey. We're scaling fast, and we're building the next generation of leaders to scale with us.

**Job Summary**
===============

The Instructional Designer owns the training that turns new hires into confident, capable operators. This person is accountable for building the new-hire onboarding curriculum, e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on exercises that teach every new employee how to do the job they were hired to do. Beyond onboarding, you will build and maintain ongoing and role-specific training, develop recurring certification and leadership development programs, deliver and support training in the field, partner with field leaders and subject-matter experts to keep content accurate as the operation evolves, and measure whether the training actually works, using completion, assessment, and on-the-job performance data to close the loop. Success in this role means new hires reach productivity faster, make fewer avoidable errors, and rate their onboarding as clear and useful.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Curriculum & Program Design**
-------------------------------

* Design and build the end-to-end new-hire onboarding curriculum for field operations roles, sequenced from first day through full productivity
* Develop e-learning modules, quizzes and knowledge checks, and hands-on, job-realistic exercises that teach new hires the specific tasks of the role they were hired for
* Develop certification programs that keep field team members' skills current and verify ongoing proficiency
* Build leadership development programs that prepare high-performing operators for management roles

**Content Development & Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Produce engaging learning content in multiple formats - e-learning, video, job aids, facilitator guides, and instructor-led sessions (in person or virtual)
* Write clear, plain-language materials a new hire can follow without needing a manual or a shadow
* Build exercises and simulations that let new hires practice real tasks in a safe setting before doing them live
* Facilitate instructor-led sessions and train field leaders to deliver content consistently

**Subject-Matter Expert Partnership**
-------------------------------------

* Partner with leaders across the Operations org to capture how the job is really done and translate it into training
* Keep curriculum accurate and current as processes, tools, and vehicle-handling standards change
* Maintain a single source of truth for the standard operating procedures and job aids used in the field

**Assessment & Effectiveness**
------------------------------

* Design quizzes, skills assessments, and role certifications that verify a new hire can do the job, not just recall information
* Track completion, assessment scores, time-to-productivity, and early performance to measure whether training is working
* Use data and learner feedback to continuously improve the curriculum and close gaps

**What You Will Have**
======================

* A builder who can take a job that lives in people’s heads and turn it into clear, teachable training
* Strong instructional-design instincts - you start from what someone needs to be able to do and design backward from there
* Excellent writing and communication skills; you make complex procedures simple
* A confident facilitator, comfortable leading training in a classroom, on the floor, or virtually
* Comfortable getting out onto the floor - you learn the operation by watching it, not just reading about it
* Highly organized and self-directed, able to run multiple content projects at once and hit launch dates
* An analytical mindset - willing to measure whether training worked and change it when it didn’t
* Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-hub operation and stays close to the field

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience designing onboarding or technical training, ideally for hourly, frontline, or field-based roles; familiarity with instructional-design methods and adult-learning principles
* Hands-on experience with building e-learning content and learning management systems (LMS)
* Experience building assessments, certifications, or competency models
* Background in operations, logistics, automotive, retail, or another hands-on field environment
* Bachelor’s degree in education, communications, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience

**What Tops The Tank**
======================

* Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
* Future Savings: Benefit from a 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
* Benefits: Day One - Excellent, low-cost healthcare coverage including medical, dental, vision.
* Drive a Flexcar! Discounted employee rate on Flexcar products and no annual membership fee.
* Weekly pay
* Other amazing perks

**Description**

When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM

Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. The ideal candidate will possess strong electronic repair skills, knowledge of server hardware, inventory and logistics experience, and the ability to work closely with internal teams, third-party logistics providers, field engineers, and customers. Service Logistics & Inventory Management

* Work with third-party logistics (3PL) providers to ensure timely parts dispatch and SLA compliance.

new_jobs.title: Community Health Worker
new_jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between community members, healthcare providers, and social service organizations. Working as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod's interdisciplinary Care Team, alongside Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs, the CHW is responsible for conducting outreach, providing health education, addressing social determinants of health, and connecting members to medical, behavioral health, and community-based resources. Under the general supervision of Enhanced Care Management Leadership, the CHW works closely with members, families, care teams, and community partners to improve health outcomes, promote self-sufficiency, and reduce barriers to care; working mainly remotely alongside the Lead Care Managers for direct member engagement. This position requires strong communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and a passion for serving diverse populations.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary team member to conduct in-person visits to community members and provide education on health-related topics.

* Assist individuals in accessing healthcare services, social services, and community resources.

* Assess social determinants of health and identify barriers impacting member well-being and healthcare access.

* Support care coordination activities and collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, social workers, and community agencies.

* Function as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod Care Team, partnering closely with Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs who conduct direct member engagement.

* Accompany members to appointments when appropriate and assist with healthcare system, insurance program, and benefit enrollment navigation.

* Maintain ongoing contact with members through phone calls, home visits, community outreach, and telehealth platforms.

* Document member interactions, assessments, and referrals accurately and timely in designated systems.

* Advocate for members and assist with resolving barriers that interfere with access to care and services.

* Participate in community outreach events, health fairs, educational workshops, and engagement activities.

* Maintain member confidentiality and comply with all organizational and regulatory requirements.

* Participate in regularly scheduled member huddles for updates and feedback.

* Reporting in-person to the office as needed for meetings.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

* **Children and Youth Involved in Child Welfare**

* **Individuals with Intellectual/ Developmental Disabilities:** Adu

new_jobs.title: Patient Enrollment Specialist
new_jobs.description:
DayaMed is seeking a motivated, personable, and results-oriented Patient Enrollment Specialist to join our growing team!

In this role, you will connect with patients referred by our partner healthcare practices, educate them about Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs, and guide interested individuals through the enrollment process.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people, communicates confidently over the phone, and thrives in a goal-oriented environment while maintaining a compassionate, patient-first approach.

Unlike traditional cold-calling positions, you will be engaging with patients who already have established relationships with our partner clinics.

Key Responsibilities

**Patient Outreach & Enrollment**

* Conduct high-volume outbound calls to eligible patients on behalf of our partner healthcare practices.
* Educate patients about RPM and CCM programs, including program benefits, participation requirements, and available support.
* Build rapport with patients, answer questions, address concerns, and help individuals make informed enrollment decisions.
* Clearly explain potential patient costs using approved and verified information.
* Obtain and accurately document patient consent in accordance with established procedures.
* Follow up with patients who need additional information or time to make an enrollment decision.

**Documentation & Coordination**

* Maintain accurate and timely records of outreach attempts, patient conversations, enrollment decisions, and follow-up activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful patient onboarding and a smooth transition into applicable programs.
* Escalate clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare professionals.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements and organizational policies.

**Performance & Accountability**

* Work toward an established goal of approximately 80–100 outbound call attempts daily.
* Target an average of 6–8 unique patient enrollments per day following an initial 30-day training and ramp-up period.
* Maintain accurate documentation and high standards of patient communication.
* Participate in ongoing training, coaching, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve patient engagement and enrollment processes.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of one year of experience in patient outreach, enrollment, customer service, call center operations, or phone-based sales.
* Excellent verbal communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain unfamiliar services clearly, accurately, and professionally.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and working toward measurable performance goals.
* Ability to accurately document information while navigating multiple computer applications.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.
* Willingness to receive feedback, participate in coaching, and contribute to team objectives.
* Commitment to protecting patient information and maintaining confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), or other healthcare enrollment programs.
* Experience communicating with Medicare beneficiaries or older adult populations.
* Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR), patient management systems, or CRM platforms.
* Experience in healthcare-related outbound calling or patient engagement.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.

What Success Looks Like

At DayaMed, we believe successful patient enrollment requires more than simply meeting a number. We value employees who can balance productivity with meaningful patient interactions.

Following an initial 30-day training and ramp-up period, performance will be evaluated using established outreach and enrollment goals, documentation accuracy, communication quality, and adherence to organizational standards.

Our priority is ensuring patients receive accurate information, understand their options, and feel supported throughout the enrollment process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

DayaMed is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Pay: $38,000.00 - $42,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Senior People Operations Coordinator, Claude Corps
new_jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

**Location:** Remote (US)
  
**Role Type:** Full-Time
  
**Reporting to:** Senior HR Business Partner, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:**$65,000 to $85,000

**About Claude Corps**

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need a coordinator who can run the day-to-day onboarding work at that scale, in partnership with the Senior HR Business Partner, and make sure every step is organized, accurate, and completed on time.

**About the Role**

You run the day-to-day onboarding work for Claude Corps fellows, from signed offer through completion of required employment steps. You send instructions, track progress, maintain employee records, and coordinate payroll and benefits setup.

The Senior HR Business Partner owns the overall onboarding process and handles sensitive questions and exceptions. You complete the work, keep fellows informed, and flag issues early.

You work closely with recruiting, the Claude Corps program team, Finance, and our HR service providers. Between onboarding waves, you help maintain records, coordinate offboarding, and improve processes so the team is ready for the next cohort.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Coordinate fellow onboarding**

* Manage onboarding for each cohort, including offer tracking, background checks, I-9 verification, employee information collection, HRIS setup in CoAdvantage, and benefits enrollment
* Track required employment steps and deadlines, ensuring fellows are ready to start on time and records are complete and accurate
* Maintain a centralized onboarding tracker, proactively identifying outstanding items, potential delays, and issues requiring escalation
* Coordinate with Finance on onboarding clearances and flag sensitive or compliance-related concerns to the Senior HR Business Partner

**Be the primary point of contact for fellows**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding questions, providing timely, clear, and supportive communication
* Send onboarding instructions, reminders, and updates so fellows understand what to expect and what actions they need to take
* Resolve routine questions and coordinate with the appropriate HR partners on benefits, system issues, or policy-related matters
* Manage the HR inbox with care, discretion, and consistent follow-through

**Maintain systems and improve processes**

new_jobs.title: Customer Experience T3 Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------

Join Instacart as a Customer Experience T3 Specialist, where you’ll play a key role in supporting the delivery experience for pharmacy orders and contributing to our mission of empowering healthier living. As part of a dedicated team, you’ll help create seamless, empathetic, and impactful interactions that enhance our customers’ trust and satisfaction with Instacart’s services.

We are currently seeking a Customer Experience T3 Specialist to join our team. In this role, you’ll be the voice of Instacart, delivering exceptional service through real-time calls and occasionally emails. You’ll work directly with customers, shoppers, pharmacists, and retail partners to create personalized support experiences that reflect empathy, kindness, and professionalism. Your work will focus on ensuring customer satisfaction by supporting Instacart Health initiatives like Fresh Funds and delivery-related inquiries for Rx orders, helping users during the moments that matter most.

The Instacart Customer Experience Consumer Vanguard team is dedicated to supporting a range of interactions across our customer, shopper, retailer, and partner community. From assisting with inquiries about Fresh Funds under our Instacart Health initiative to supporting Rx customers with prescription delivery and related questions, we provide empathetic and solutions-focused service. Whether resolving app issues or troubleshooting delivery concerns, our team is committed to advocating on behalf of our users and creating exceptional support experiences that contribute to Instacart’s vision of accessible and reliable services for all.

**About the Job**
-----------------

* Take ownership of delivering real-time support to customers with a focus on Rx delivery-related inquiries and Instacart Health programs like Fresh Funds.
* Leverage exceptional problem-solving skills to provide fast, effective resolutions while navigating complex and evolving challenges at scale.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment where processes may rapidly change, and new priorities emerge without warning.
* Communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally across all interactions, ensuring a personalized and meaningful service experience that builds lasting trust.
* Embrace operational ownership by proactively identifying trends in customer feedback and collaborating with your Manager to streamline processes and improve outcomes.

**About You**
-------------

***Minimum Qualifications***

* 1+ years of experience in customer service or call center support, with a proven ability to handle high-pressure scenarios.
* Superior communication skills, including clear and professional phone etiquette and excellent written skills.
* Comfort and proficiency with technology, from navigating web-based support platforms to using and troubleshooting smartphone apps (iPhone/Android).
* A proven ability to multitask, prioritize, and problem-solve in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
* A strong sense of empathy, customer advocacy, and sound judgment for creating positive outcomes in difficult or time-sensitive situations.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience in delivery-focused customer support, particularly within delivery apps
* Familiarity with handling inbound customer service calls and/or working within HIPAA-compliant environments.
* Prior experience in a fast-paced, metrics-driven contact center setting.
* Proficiency with customer support tools like Salesforce, Geneys, Admin or similar platforms.
* A demonstrated ability to identify trends and provide feedback for continuous improvement in processes and workflows*.*

***Work Schedule:***  
*The working hours for this role are* ***Wednesday – Sunday, 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM ET*** *or* ***Friday - Tuesday 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM ET.***

*#LI-Remote*

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Project Managers are responsible for the initiating, planning, executing, monitoring & controlling, and closing CSI internal, departmental, and customer facing projects with new and existing customers with the overall accountability for the success for projects assigned.

In addition to direct project management responsibilities, this role provides portfolio management and oversight for a high-volume portfolio of smaller, repeatable projects. This includes maintaining visibility across the portfolio, coordinating priorities and assignments, monitoring progress and capacity, identifying projects requiring attention, and providing portfolio-level reporting and insights to support effective delivery.

**Project Management Responsibilities**

**Initiation**

* Drives effective hand over from project sponsor
* Executes kick-off meeting

**Planning**

* Reviews standard project plan and refines as required for each project base on complexity factors and impacts as identified by the team
* Ensures all team members are assigned to required project roles
* Reviews project plan highlights and team with the customer
* Discusses critical project success factors with the customer and gains their buy-in to support

**Execution**

* Establishes initial project setup
* Regularly engages and communicates with project teams to ensure project is progressing as planned
* Proactively identifies and manages key project issues & risks

**Monitoring & Controlling**

* Regularly reviews project plan and other available information to gauge project status
* Regularly reviews time reporting to ensure actual work is in line with planned work
* Executes regular internal and external project status meetings
* Provides regular written project status updates
* Performs proactive and disciplined escalations of issues and risks that may put the project in jeopardy status

**Closing (completion and closure)**

* Executes post project review meeting to identify lessons learned
* Executes project surveys to obtain the voice of the customer feedback and overall customer satisfaction with the project

**Other**

* Proactively engages and contributes to building and continually improving methodologies, processes, and documentation
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Portfolio Management Responsibilities**

* Maintains visibility across a high-volume portfolio of smaller, repeatable projects, monitoring status, key milestones, priorities, risks, and expected completion dates.
* Coordinates project intake, assignment, prioritization, and sequencing to support customer commitments, business priorities, and efficient delivery.
* Proactively identifies projects that are stalled, at risk, or not progressing as expected and drives appropriate follow-up, intervention, and escalation.
* Monitors workload and resource capacity across the portfolio, identifying constraints, competing priorities, and potential impacts to delivery.
* Provides portfolio-level reporting and insights to leadership, highlighting overall health, trends, risks, throughput, upcoming demand, and areas requiring attention or decisions.
* Drives consistency in project execution, portfolio data quality, and timely project closure while identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and scalability.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience
* A minimum of four (4) years of experience managing multiple project engagements
* Experience supporting internal and/or customer‑facing projects with defined scope and timelines
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
* Ability to proactively identify risks, solve problems, and manage competing priorities
* Technical aptitude with the ability to quickly understand infrastructure-related projects and effectively collaborate with technical teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP (Project Management Professional) or CAPM certification
* Familiarity with project management tools and Agile methodologies

**What Success Looks Like**

* Projects delivered on time, within scope, and on budget
* Strong stakeholder relationships and communication
* Proactive risk management and issue resolution
* Continuous improvement of project processes
* Maintains a healthy, well-managed portfolio by ensuring projects are appropriately prioritized, progressing as expected, risks and constraints are proactively addressed, and leadership has clear visibility into overall performance and areas requiring attention.

**Work Environment**

* Interaction with internal teams, external customers, and senior leadership
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment

new_jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

### **Overview**

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

### **About the Job**

**Program Operations & SLA Governance:**

* Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.
* Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.
* Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.
* Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

**Proactive Service Recovery:**

* Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.
* Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

Goshen Accounting Services is a small, fully remote firm that serves as the finance team for nonprofit organizations. We handle fund accounting, grant compliance, audit preparation, Form 990s, and fractional CFO work for organizations whose missions matter to us.

We are looking for a Client Success and Operations Specialist to be the steady, clear voice our clients hear between the numbers. You will own day-to-day client communication and coordination, make sound judgment calls within defined limits, and know when a matter needs Goshen's Senior Manager.

This is not a calendar-and-inbox role. We need someone who can read a situation, decide what it calls for, and write a message a client can act on without needing to ask a follow-up question.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* **Client communication:** Respond to client emails and requests that need judgment, in clear, warm, and professional writing on Goshen's behalf.
* **Deliverable coordination:** Track every client deadline, including month-end closes, board packages, audit requests, and filings, and keep our bookkeeping partner on schedule.
* **Document compliance and risk monitoring:** Review client document submissions for completeness and compliance, so we have everything needed to update financial records and manage grants. Follow up on missing items and flag client concerns, scope changes, or deadline risks to Goshen's Senior Manager before they become problems.
* **Firm operations:** Handle client onboarding paperwork, document collection, and the operational follow-through that keeps client work moving. Manage the firm's expenses and support the recruitment process for our accounting team.
* **Cross-team coordination:** Work alongside leadership, business development, client account owners, and our billing, payables, and receivables functions to resolve issues and keep deliverables on track.
* **Client onboarding and systems training:** Help bring new clients on board, support the rollout of the systems and tools we implement for them, and train and coach their staff to use those tools with confidence.
* **Judgment within clear limits:** You will work from a written decision-rights list that spells out what you decide alone, what you decide and report, and what you escalate first. Your authority grows as you show sound judgment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

**You must have:**

* At least 5 years in a client-facing coordination or client service role at an accounting firm, or in a similar role communicating directly with executive leaders such as CEOs, executive directors, and CFOs.
* Written communication that is clear on the first read. Your messages lead with the point, make one specific request, and name who does what by when.
* Strong comfort with technology. You learn new software quickly, troubleshoot issues on your own, and can teach others to use a tool step by step. This includes a strong working command of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Gmail, and of CRM and database platforms.
* A problem-solving mindset. When something is stuck, you find the cause, propose a fix, and follow through rather than waiting to be told.
* Professional, warm communication by phone and video as well as in writing, with a client-first mindset and genuine empathy for clients working under pressure.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail; manage your time well, and keep several priorities moving at once in a fast-paced environment.
* Examples of decisions you made on your own, and of times you recognized something was above your authority and escalated it.
* Comfort with accounting deadlines and terms (month-end close, audit, grant reporting) well enough to spot risk. You do not need to do the accounting.
* Experience working remotely and independently, with little day-to-day supervision.
* Respect for confidentiality, including sensitive client and HR information.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with Asana, QuickBooks Online, or similar tools.
* Experience coordinating work with an outsourced team or vendor.

**HOW WE WORK**

* Async first. We work mostly in writing, through Asana and email, with documented processes and standard operating procedures. You will rarely wait for a meeting to move work forward.
* High standards. Our firm holds a 98% accuracy standard, and we expect the same care in client communication.
* Room to grow. Your decision-making authority expands at set review points as you show sound judgment.
* Schedule: This role starts part-time at 20 hours per week, with availability during our business hours. Hours will grow as our client base and capacity needs increase.

**HOW TO APPLY**

* Your resume.
* Your written answer to our given scenario in 150 words or fewer.

Pay: $27.00 - $36.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) 3% Match
* Internet reimbursement
* Professional development assistance
* Work from home

Our bookkeeping team says the month-end close will not be finished until Wednesday. Write the reply you would send to the executive director, then add one or two sentences on what you would do next and why.

* client-facing coordination or client service: 5 years (Required)
